  40. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.34

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Stable

    Released
    14 Nov 2026
    Changes
    52

    Fixed false MCP startup session.error events when quitting or switching sessions cancels in-progress MCP startup; genuine startup failures on live sessions are still reported. Fixed session.plugins.list incorrectly reporting user-installed plugins as disabled when an organization requires managed plugins; enabled states now respect user settings unless explicitly overridden.

    Key changes

    • Fixed false MCP startup session.error events when quitting or switching sessions cancels in-progress MCP startup; genuine startup failures on live sessions are still reported.
    • Fixed session.plugins.list incorrectly reporting user-installed plugins as disabled when an organization requires managed plugins; enabled states now respect user settings unless explicitly overridden.
    • Fix taskAnalytics.classifyTrajectory retries rejecting an unchanged archive whose JSON object keys were stored in a different order. Results from earlier versions need one fresh analysis.
    • TeamPluginMarketplaceSource in session.plugins.getDefaults includes the Team's ref and path when it sets them.
    $ gh release view v1.0.34 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 52 changes

    Changes 52

    • Fixed false MCP startup session.error events when quitting or switching sessions cancels in-progress MCP startup; genuine startup failures on live sessions are still reported.
    • Fixed session.plugins.list incorrectly reporting user-installed plugins as disabled when an organization requires managed plugins; enabled states now respect user settings unless explicitly overridden.
    • Fix taskAnalytics.classifyTrajectory retries rejecting an unchanged archive whose JSON object keys were stored in a different order. Results from earlier versions need one fresh analysis.
    • TeamPluginMarketplaceSource in session.plugins.getDefaults includes the Team's ref and path when it sets them.
    • Hardened TCP JSON-RPC servers to reject HTTP requests and disconnect clients sending invalid header names; standard SDK clients are unaffected.
    • ACP TCP servers now require loopback hosts and disconnect clients sending invalid UTF-8 or non-JSON lines; stdio behavior is unchanged.
    • Announced the transition to the Microsoft Copilot SDK.
    • Fixed retained Microsoft Entra metadata refresh and Microsoft 365 account projection consistency.
    • Fixed session.plugins.retryManaged on the standalone host to retry all or selected required plugins without waiting for the automatic retry pause, activate prepared plugins, and return per-plugin results and errors.
    • Add experimental saved-provider inspection, editing, and removal, with explicit session.provider updates for live application.
    • Sessionless discovery and inert plugin inventory now honor authenticated Team plugin defaults without changing saved preferences or activating contributions.
    • SDK sessions now use the model's preferred context tier when no explicit or saved tier is set; models without a preference retain existing behavior. Claude Haiku 5.5 sessions now default to a 936K prompt budget instead of 100K.
    • Defaulting to long context can incur higher token rates without explicit opt-in; billing still depends on actual prompt size.
    • Security-review scan tools disclose captured unchanged supporting context and distinguish changed-only, supporting-only, and mixed evidence blobs.
    • Fixed supported document attachments in GPT sessions using WebSocket Responses being sent as local file references instead of document contents.
    • Reduced peak memory usage and improved performance when forking sessions with large histories through sessions.fork.
    • Simplified sessions.fork write-failure messages from "Persistence error: I/O error: ..." to "I/O error: ...".
    • Windows SDK networking now enforces Windows certificate distrust even with custom CAs, and excludes distrusted certificates from trust bundles supplied to child processes.
    • Windows credential-proxy and affected tunneled HTTPS connections now use native Windows TLS, preserving revocation checks and support for non-exportable system client-certificate keys.
    • The native runtime no longer hangs at startup when another process holds its log directory's lock; it starts with process file logging disabled and a stderr warning.
    • session.rpc.history.setCompactionConfig({ model }) now applies to sessions using a custom (BYOK) provider: compaction summarizes on another model that provider serves, through the same provider.
    • Persisted session.usage_record events no longer store /interactions as the usage apiEndpoint, so runtimes released before that value can resume those sessions, and a usage record whose endpoint the runtime does not know now loads without it instead of failing the resume.
    • Fixed indexed search permanently falling back to scan-based search after temporary memory pressure. Sessions now retry within the indexing operation timeout, using scans until indexed search becomes available.
    • Enable dynamic workflows for Microsoft 365 accounts without requiring GitHub billing or BYOK configuration.
    • Preserve pending external tool requests when an SDK client disconnects during request publication.
    • Fix a race where subagent retirement after an external tool response could prevent the parent response from reaching the SDK.
    • Fixed plugins.install failing with "Marketplace not found" for an owner/repo:path source whose path contains @; it now installs from that repository path.
    • Fix providers.config.updateModel and updateProvider deleting saved capability and Azure settings that providers.config.read does not return.
    • Java: Javadoc now shows schema descriptions that contain a less-than sign as written, instead of an invalid input error or a hidden placeholder such as the token in Authorization: Bearer, and the SystemMessageMode.CUSTOMIZE and ToolResultObject.binaryResultsForLlm() references on SectionOverride, SectionOverrideAction, SystemMessageSections and ToolBinaryResult resolve.
    • A failed compaction reports the provider's error message in the session.history.compact error and in session.compaction_complete.error, without an internal host-rethrow prefix
    • BYOK providers on the WebSockets transport now run apiKeyCommand and bearerTokenProvider once per model request instead of twice.
    • Session AI credit limits now count the credits a session used before it was resumed, so a resumed session can no longer spend its full limit again.
    • Gemini models on the Interactions API stream a blank line between thought summaries in assistant.reasoning_delta, as the reasoning text of the same response has with streaming off
    • Fix in-process hosts ignoring COPILOT_DISABLE_KEYTAR from their isolated environment.
    • Node.js and Python: a relative CLI path (explicit path or COPILOT_CLI_PATH) is now checked in the client's working directory, where the runtime starts, instead of the process's current directory.
    • Python: CopilotClient.force_stop() on a TCP or URI connection no longer logs "Failed to parse incoming JSON-RPC message" with a traceback when a message was arriving as the connection closed.
    • Assisted permissions keep using the judge after a person approves an action too long for the judge to review, instead of falling back to manual prompts for the rest of the session.
    • Improved assisted permission checks in delegated sessions to distinguish agent claims from user authorization and better honor quoted user stop, pause, cancellation, and scope limits.
    • Fixed session listing with an empty filter to return the same sessions as an unfiltered call, including local sessions with no recorded working directory.
    • sessions.enrichMetadata now reports isDetached: true for a detached session that a sessions.list call with metadataLimit returned as not detached.
    • A sub-agent's client-tool call is now recorded as completed in the session history, and its external_tool.completed event carries the sub-agent's agentId like its request.
    • session.create and session.resume now report a model id the model list does not offer as not available when a reasoningEffort is also given, instead of as an unsupported reasoning effort.
    • Fixed an issue where an enabled plugin in a local directory marketplace whose source points to a file prevented all MCP servers from starting. The invalid plugin is now skipped with a warning identifying the plugin and path.
    • Fixed an issue where cancelling a finished sub-agent with session.tasks.cancel could leave the parent's session.idle event missing and sendAndWait pending after its background shells stopped.
    • API docs no longer name the nonexistent methods hooks.loadResources, user.settings.load, user.settings.governanceKeys and user.settings.unknownKeys or the nonexistent event session.context_info_changed; they name hooks.discover, user.settings.loadWithWarning, user.settings.listGovernanceKeys, user.settings.getUnknownKeysWarning and session.usage_info.
    • Fixed intention summaries for structured ask_user calls to show the question message instead of "Waiting for response"; legacy call summaries are unchanged.
    • Session events: session.permission_recovery attempts can carry an optional reviewIncomplete flag for a deferral caused by an automatic permission review that ended without a verdict (timeout, empty or unparseable reply).
    • Rewinding to a message sent with mode "immediate" while the agent was working now restores the files the agent changed in reply to it.
    • Fixed subagents ignoring session-wide usage when enforcing sessionLimits.maxAiCredits. Subagents now block further model calls once the soft cap is reached, make a final tool-free call when 10% or less remains, and skip response tool calls if the cap is exceeded during that response.
    • Fixed a lost queue wakeup when resuming during drain retirement.
    • Improve best-effort compatibility on unsupported macOS 13 systems without expanding official OS support. The bundled CLI requires macOS 13.5 or later; HPKE-dependent authentication now reports an explicit macOS 14 requirement.
    • All: Fixed Team plugin defaults after account changes while preserving explicit session credentials.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.34 Changelog Release notes →

  42. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.34-preview.0

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Prerelease

    Released
    13 Nov 2026
    Changes
    52

    Fixed false MCP startup session.error events when quitting or switching sessions cancels in-progress MCP startup; genuine startup failures on live sessions are still reported. Fixed session.plugins.list incorrectly reporting user-installed plugins as disabled when an organization requires managed plugins; enabled states now respect user settings unless explicitly overridden.

    Key changes

    • Fixed false MCP startup session.error events when quitting or switching sessions cancels in-progress MCP startup; genuine startup failures on live sessions are still reported.
    • Fixed session.plugins.list incorrectly reporting user-installed plugins as disabled when an organization requires managed plugins; enabled states now respect user settings unless explicitly overridden.
    • Fix taskAnalytics.classifyTrajectory retries rejecting an unchanged archive whose JSON object keys were stored in a different order. Results from earlier versions need one fresh analysis.
    • TeamPluginMarketplaceSource in session.plugins.getDefaults includes the Team's ref and path when it sets them.
    $ gh release view v1.0.34-preview.0 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 52 changes

    Changes 52

    • Fixed false MCP startup session.error events when quitting or switching sessions cancels in-progress MCP startup; genuine startup failures on live sessions are still reported.
    • Fixed session.plugins.list incorrectly reporting user-installed plugins as disabled when an organization requires managed plugins; enabled states now respect user settings unless explicitly overridden.
    • Fix taskAnalytics.classifyTrajectory retries rejecting an unchanged archive whose JSON object keys were stored in a different order. Results from earlier versions need one fresh analysis.
    • TeamPluginMarketplaceSource in session.plugins.getDefaults includes the Team's ref and path when it sets them.
    • Hardened TCP JSON-RPC servers to reject HTTP requests and disconnect clients sending invalid header names; standard SDK clients are unaffected.
    • ACP TCP servers now require loopback hosts and disconnect clients sending invalid UTF-8 or non-JSON lines; stdio behavior is unchanged.
    • Announced the transition to the Microsoft Copilot SDK.
    • Fixed retained Microsoft Entra metadata refresh and Microsoft 365 account projection consistency.
    • Fixed session.plugins.retryManaged on the standalone host to retry all or selected required plugins without waiting for the automatic retry pause, activate prepared plugins, and return per-plugin results and errors.
    • Add experimental saved-provider inspection, editing, and removal, with explicit session.provider updates for live application.
    • Sessionless discovery and inert plugin inventory now honor authenticated Team plugin defaults without changing saved preferences or activating contributions.
    • SDK sessions now use the model's preferred context tier when no explicit or saved tier is set; models without a preference retain existing behavior. Claude Haiku 5.5 sessions now default to a 936K prompt budget instead of 100K.
    • Defaulting to long context can incur higher token rates without explicit opt-in; billing still depends on actual prompt size.
    • Security-review scan tools disclose captured unchanged supporting context and distinguish changed-only, supporting-only, and mixed evidence blobs.
    • Fixed supported document attachments in GPT sessions using WebSocket Responses being sent as local file references instead of document contents.
    • Reduced peak memory usage and improved performance when forking sessions with large histories through sessions.fork.
    • Simplified sessions.fork write-failure messages from "Persistence error: I/O error: ..." to "I/O error: ...".
    • Windows SDK networking now enforces Windows certificate distrust even with custom CAs, and excludes distrusted certificates from trust bundles supplied to child processes.
    • Windows credential-proxy and affected tunneled HTTPS connections now use native Windows TLS, preserving revocation checks and support for non-exportable system client-certificate keys.
    • The native runtime no longer hangs at startup when another process holds its log directory's lock; it starts with process file logging disabled and a stderr warning.
    • session.rpc.history.setCompactionConfig({ model }) now applies to sessions using a custom (BYOK) provider: compaction summarizes on another model that provider serves, through the same provider.
    • Persisted session.usage_record events no longer store /interactions as the usage apiEndpoint, so runtimes released before that value can resume those sessions, and a usage record whose endpoint the runtime does not know now loads without it instead of failing the resume.
    • Fixed indexed search permanently falling back to scan-based search after temporary memory pressure. Sessions now retry within the indexing operation timeout, using scans until indexed search becomes available.
    • Enable dynamic workflows for Microsoft 365 accounts without requiring GitHub billing or BYOK configuration.
    • Preserve pending external tool requests when an SDK client disconnects during request publication.
    • Fix a race where subagent retirement after an external tool response could prevent the parent response from reaching the SDK.
    • Fixed plugins.install failing with "Marketplace not found" for an owner/repo:path source whose path contains @; it now installs from that repository path.
    • Fix providers.config.updateModel and updateProvider deleting saved capability and Azure settings that providers.config.read does not return.
    • Java: Javadoc now shows schema descriptions that contain a less-than sign as written, instead of an invalid input error or a hidden placeholder such as the token in Authorization: Bearer, and the SystemMessageMode.CUSTOMIZE and ToolResultObject.binaryResultsForLlm() references on SectionOverride, SectionOverrideAction, SystemMessageSections and ToolBinaryResult resolve.
    • A failed compaction reports the provider's error message in the session.history.compact error and in session.compaction_complete.error, without an internal host-rethrow prefix
    • BYOK providers on the WebSockets transport now run apiKeyCommand and bearerTokenProvider once per model request instead of twice.
    • Session AI credit limits now count the credits a session used before it was resumed, so a resumed session can no longer spend its full limit again.
    • Gemini models on the Interactions API stream a blank line between thought summaries in assistant.reasoning_delta, as the reasoning text of the same response has with streaming off
    • Fix in-process hosts ignoring COPILOT_DISABLE_KEYTAR from their isolated environment.
    • Node.js and Python: a relative CLI path (explicit path or COPILOT_CLI_PATH) is now checked in the client's working directory, where the runtime starts, instead of the process's current directory.
    • Python: CopilotClient.force_stop() on a TCP or URI connection no longer logs "Failed to parse incoming JSON-RPC message" with a traceback when a message was arriving as the connection closed.
    • Assisted permissions keep using the judge after a person approves an action too long for the judge to review, instead of falling back to manual prompts for the rest of the session.
    • Improved assisted permission checks in delegated sessions to distinguish agent claims from user authorization and better honor quoted user stop, pause, cancellation, and scope limits.
    • Fixed session listing with an empty filter to return the same sessions as an unfiltered call, including local sessions with no recorded working directory.
    • sessions.enrichMetadata now reports isDetached: true for a detached session that a sessions.list call with metadataLimit returned as not detached.
    • A sub-agent's client-tool call is now recorded as completed in the session history, and its external_tool.completed event carries the sub-agent's agentId like its request.
    • session.create and session.resume now report a model id the model list does not offer as not available when a reasoningEffort is also given, instead of as an unsupported reasoning effort.
    • Fixed an issue where an enabled plugin in a local directory marketplace whose source points to a file prevented all MCP servers from starting. The invalid plugin is now skipped with a warning identifying the plugin and path.
    • Fixed an issue where cancelling a finished sub-agent with session.tasks.cancel could leave the parent's session.idle event missing and sendAndWait pending after its background shells stopped.
    • API docs no longer name the nonexistent methods hooks.loadResources, user.settings.load, user.settings.governanceKeys and user.settings.unknownKeys or the nonexistent event session.context_info_changed; they name hooks.discover, user.settings.loadWithWarning, user.settings.listGovernanceKeys, user.settings.getUnknownKeysWarning and session.usage_info.
    • Fixed intention summaries for structured ask_user calls to show the question message instead of "Waiting for response"; legacy call summaries are unchanged.
    • Session events: session.permission_recovery attempts can carry an optional reviewIncomplete flag for a deferral caused by an automatic permission review that ended without a verdict (timeout, empty or unparseable reply).
    • Rewinding to a message sent with mode "immediate" while the agent was working now restores the files the agent changed in reply to it.
    • Fixed subagents ignoring session-wide usage when enforcing sessionLimits.maxAiCredits. Subagents now block further model calls once the soft cap is reached, make a final tool-free call when 10% or less remains, and skip response tool calls if the cap is exceeded during that response.
    • Fixed a lost queue wakeup when resuming during drain retirement.
    • Improve best-effort compatibility on unsupported macOS 13 systems without expanding official OS support. The bundled CLI requires macOS 13.5 or later; HPKE-dependent authentication now reports an explicit macOS 14 requirement.
    • All: Fixed Team plugin defaults after account changes while preserving explicit session credentials.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.34-preview.0 Changelog Release notes →

Fix .NET shell authentication cancellation cleanup callbacks being lost when a request finishes before queued notifications run.

    Key changes

    • Fixed a CLI issue where the /usage activity graph wrapped in narrow terminals; it now fits correctly.
    • The permission_prompt notification hook no longer runs for a permission request that Assisted Permissions approves without asking.
    • Fix .NET shell authentication cancellation cleanup callbacks being lost when a request finishes before queued notifications run.

    $ gh release view v1.0.33 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 68 changes

    Changes 68

    • Fixed a CLI issue where the /usage activity graph wrapped in narrow terminals; it now fits correctly.
    • The permission_prompt notification hook no longer runs for a permission request that Assisted Permissions approves without asking.
    • Fix .NET shell authentication cancellation cleanup callbacks being lost when a request finishes before queued notifications run.
    • Node.js: start() after a lost TCP connection now terminates the runtime process the client spawned before starting a new one, so stop() no longer leaves the old runtime running.
    • session.workflow.run no longer fails when a SessionFs SQLite provider commits the run but reports postCommitAmbiguous; the committed run starts.
    • .NET: ListSessionsAsync now applies SessionListFilter.WorkingDirectory instead of returning sessions from every directory.
    • Improved quota accuracy by refreshing plan quota from the Copilot user in /usage and account.getQuota.
    • Fixed a runtime stability issue where the SDK host could abort if its standard error stream was closed.
    • Marketplace browse results include managedDesiredEnabled for plugins controlled by managed settings; installing a plugin blocked by managed settings is refused with error data code managed_policy_blocked.
    • Go: Ping, GetStatus, GetAuthStatus, ListModels and RuntimePort no longer data-race a concurrent Start, Stop or ForceStop; during Start the first four wait for it to finish.
    • Managed Shell(...), Bash(...), and PowerShell(...) permission rules accept JavaScript regular expressions written as /pattern/flags, including patterns that contain ). A regular expression that runs longer than 1 second, cannot start within 1 second because too many others are running, or ignores case in a way that cannot be matched as JavaScript matches it counts as a match for deny and ask rules and does not approve the command for allow rules.
    • Behavior change: a managed shell rule argument written as /pattern/flags is now a regular expression, except a command path such as Shell(/usr/bin/id) or an invalid regular expression, which are read as literal text and get a managedSettings.validate warning.
    • Add source skill install and removal APIs across all SDK languages.
    • .NET: A call that waits for another caller's StartAsync to finish now stops when its own CancellationToken is cancelled.
    • Plugin list entries now include team: true when the signed-in account's GitHub Team assigns the plugin.
    • Add non-blocking workflow admission, workflow-scoped custom agents, and per-agent deadlines to Dynamic Workflows.
    • Fixed shell tool results and telemetry to report when attached shells were stopped by session.abort(), agent termination, sandbox changes, or provider policy stops instead of incorrectly attributing them to stop_bash. Shell termination behavior is unchanged.
    • Go: ResumeSession and DeleteSession no longer race a concurrent Start under the Go race detector.
    • Sandboxed local MCP initialization errors now identify the refused filesystem operation when a Node server crashes with its default stack trace.
    • Report enterprise MCP policy blocks instead of intentional server stops for MCP App requests.
    • Workspace MCP servers (.mcp.json, .github/mcp.json) with a relative cwd now start in that path under the directory holding the config file, instead of under the process working directory.
    • session.mcp.getToolTokenBreakdown and session.tools.getCurrentMetadata now report tools that generic client tool search left out of the last request as deferred, instead of counting them as sent in full.
    • Fixed Windows sandbox path handling to prevent PATH and tool environment entries with drive-like components from granting unintended read access to drive roots or session-directory ancestors.
    • Steered messages sent with mode immediate now include hasSubmittedTask on their user.message event, like other new user messages.
    • Node.js: start() called after the runtime exited now starts a new runtime right away, even when a process the runtime started still holds its output open, instead of returning while the client stays on the exited runtime.
    • Java, Python, and Rust now honor COPILOT_CLI_PATH without silently substituting another runtime when the selected installation is invalid.
    • Go: Client.Start called after the runtime exited now starts a new runtime even when the old connection has not finished closing, instead of returning nil and leaving the client on the exited runtime.
    • Python: start() called after a request failed because the connection to the runtime was lost now starts a new connection instead of returning while the client is still on the closed one.
    • session.history.rewind now works on sessions stored through a session filesystem provider, and on sessions created with configDirectory; it used to fail with truncation-failed.
    • Model-switch messages and compaction confirmations now display preview and hidden models as “Hidden Model N” when streamer mode is enabled.
    • excludedTools that is not an array of strings is now rejected with an error instead of making every subagent of the session fail.
    • Node.js: stop() and forceStop() called while start() is still connecting over TCP now end that connect right away, so start() rejects and stop() returns at once instead of waiting up to 10 seconds for the connect timeout.
    • .NET: CopilotClient.RuntimePort returns null after StopAsync, ForceStopAsync or a failed StartAsync of a runtime the client started, instead of the stopped runtime's port. A client of an external runtime keeps its configured port.
    • Added experimental sessions.hasEvents and shell.buildInteractiveEnvironment methods across all six SDKs, with Node.js payload types available from the package root.
    • Java RPC diagnostics now redact hostEnvironment and returned environment fields without changing request or response contents.
    • Generated Rust Debug, Python repr, and Java toString omit interactive-shell environment maps without changing wire values.
    • Fixed late cancellation of a completed user-requested shell command incorrectly aborting the next command that reuses its request ID.
    • Fixed excessive memory use in session.workspaces.diff for large untracked files; oversized files remain marked as truncated.
    • Workspace diffs now show untracked symlinks by their target path without opening the target, avoiding hangs and unintended reads outside the repository.
    • Workspace diffs now preserve executable permissions in diff headers for untracked files.
    • Go and Python: Start/start() called after the stdio runtime exited now starts a new runtime, even when a process the runtime started still holds its output open, instead of returning while the client stays on the exited runtime.
    • Node.js, Python: ping, getStatus, getAuthStatus and listModels called while start() is running now wait for it and then use the new connection, or fail with the start's error, instead of failing with Client not connected or sending their request before the connection handshake.
    • .NET and Java: StartAsync()/start() after the runtime process exits now starts a new runtime instead of succeeding on the dead connection.
    • .NET: StartServerAsync, RestartServerAsync and Config.AddAsync/UpdateAsync accept McpStdioServerConfig and McpHttpServerConfig with unset optional fields again, instead of failing with timeout: Expected integer.
    • Go: Client.RuntimePort returns 0 after a Start that fails and stops the runtime the client started, instead of that runtime's port. A URIConnection client keeps its configured port.
    • Fixed userPromptSubmitted hooks so additionalContext from every hook, including extensions that join a session, reaches the model in run order instead of only the last hook's.
    • Built-in CLI documentation now includes --allow-tool rule examples, clarifies that rules apply only to the current run, and points to the full permission syntax.
    • .NET: a client that spawns its runtime now starts the bundled runtime when COPILOT_CLI_PATH is set to an empty value, instead of failing with "Cannot start process because a file name has not been provided".
    • Fixed session.mcp.oauth.probe to report needs-auth instead of failed when a Streamable HTTP MCP server returns 401 with empty or whitespace-only WWW-Authenticate headers.
    • SDK clients can create sessions on AHP hosts launched with --host-allow-session-creation alongside --host-ahp or --host-environment, without changing saved settings.
    • Child system notifications preserve their subagent attribution in session event streams.
    • Hosted programmatic tool calling supports suffixed OpenAI model IDs.
    • Malformed config.json files are now preserved instead of overwritten during startup or state updates. Sessions warn and continue without the saved state until the file is fixed.
    • On macOS, sessions that allow the temp directory now also allow the user's own files under /tmp without a path permission request.
    • Steered messages sent with mode immediate now carry the running turn's parentAgentTaskId on their user.message event, like the turn's first message.
    • Fixed session.workspaces.diff returning garbled added lines for untracked binary files; it now returns a binary-file notice instead.
    • A waiting session.eventLog.read no longer spins until its deadline after compaction or a history rewrite, and no longer skips events emitted after compaction removed earlier events.
    • Fixed session.workspaces.diff to list copied files as added under their new names when Git copy detection is enabled, without duplicating source entries or including source edits in copy patches.
    • Fixed session.workspaces.diff omitting the last listed file when its name ends in a space.
    • Improved runtime behavior so steer requests sent at the end of a turn are processed immediately instead of waiting behind background agent work.
    • An Auto session whose token renewal moves to another model continues the turn on that model instead of failing.
    • When ASYNC_SUBAGENTS is enabled, the task tool takes a wait timeout instead of a sync/background mode, and task agents stay reusable for follow-up messages.
    • plugins.enable, plugins.disable, plugins.update and plugins.uninstall now fail with the file path when config.json cannot be parsed, instead of reporting no change or that the plugin is not installed.
    • Deleting a session while one of its client tool handlers is running now publishes external_tool.completed for the outstanding request, so the handler's cancellation signal fires, as it does for abort.
    • Fixed an issue where a failed skills reload removed all SDK-provided skills.
    • Fixed OAuth sign-in for remote MCP servers through proxies that require Kerberos (Negotiate) authentication.
    • Protected local sessions can create, read and edit eligible extension sources while enforcing filesystem restrictions; provider and LSP permissions remain unchanged.
    • Rewind points, rewind previews and conversation-and-files rewinds no longer count or report a file that the rewound turns left unchanged.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.33 Changelog Release notes →

  47. GitHub Agentic Workflows v1.2.3

    GitHub Agentic Workflows

    Prerelease

    Released
    13 Nov 2026
    Changes
    180

    v1.2.3 centers on model routing, safer connectors and merges, and a Go 1.27.4 baseline that fixes an HTTP/1 server crash. It also adds security hardening across temporary files, installers, and workflow handling.

    Key changes

    • v1.2.3 centers on model routing, safer connectors and merges, and a Go 1.27.4 baseline that fixes an HTTP/1 server crash. It also adds security hardening across temporary files, installers, and workflow handling.
    $ gh release view v1.2.3 --repo github/gh-aw
    All 180 changes

    🌟 Release Highlights 1

    • v1.2.3 centers on model routing, safer connectors and merges, and a Go 1.27.4 baseline that fixes an HTTP/1 server crash. It also adds security hardening across temporary files, installers, and workflow handling.

    ⚠️ Breaking Changes 10

    • Default model routing changed. Eligible workflows that set neither a model nor routing now use goal: cost, mode: auto on GitHub Copilot. Recompile and review model, output, and cost changes. To keep the previous non-routed selection, set engine.model-routing: false. Learn more
    • Native Jira, Linear, and Azure DevOps integrations are replaced by declarative connectors. Import .github/workflows/connectors/<provider>.md, select read profiles and write effects, configure credentials, then recompile. Learn more
    • merge-pull-request blocks PRs that change protected files. Merge those manually, add safe-outputs.merge-pull-request.protected-files.exclude entries, or set protected-files: allowed when intentional.
    • pull_request_target admits same-repository PRs only by default. List exact owner/repo entries under forks to admit forks, then recompile.
    • AWF and Copilot CLI downloads require a checksum pin. Supply sandbox.agent.checksums-sha256 or engine.checksums-sha256 with an explicit version. Unpinned and latest downloads now fail closed.
    • Go 1.27.4 is required for repository builds and release binaries. Older toolchains are rejected.
    • MCP workflow-writing tools are disabled by default. Enable add, update, fix, and compile with gh aw mcp-server --allow-write-tools.
    • Graders run in conclusion as pure computation. Custom JavaScript and Bash graders run in a separate graders job. Recompile workflows and move Bash graders from stdin to $1 / GH_AW_SESSION_FILE.
    • CLI changes. gh aw outcomes is removed; use gh aw logs --outcomes. gh aw logs now defaults to a 1 GB storage budget (--max-storage 0 for unlimited).
    • Work-queue setup. Remove initializeWorkQueue and pre-submission policy commands. The first accepted submission creates the policy.

    ✨ What's New 7

    • Model routing by name. Set model: router, router/economy, router/balanced, or router/robust instead of a separate routing block. Learn more
    • Security advisory safe outputs. create-security-advisory creates draft advisories only and never publishes them. add-security-advisory-comment posts comments by GHSA ID. Learn more
    • Protected-file checks for merges. merge-pull-request inspects the live PR file list before merging.
    • Streaming logs. gh aw logs --format jsonl emits progress and run data while collection runs.
    • Work-queue bootstrap. Global queue config moves to .github/workflows/aw.json under work_queue, with first-use bootstrap. Learn more
    • Declarative connector conformance. Daily conformance workflows now cover all 14 connectors.
    • Experimental Atomic engine. Atomic output now flows into the unified session format and step summaries.

    🐛 Bug Fixes &amp; Improvements 8

    • Connector safe outputs no longer fail with Unknown connector argument (#76981).
    • The Copilot harness honors Retry-After on HTTP 429 with bounded waits (#76807).
    • Safe-output URL redaction no longer corrupts HTML tag boundaries (#76719).
    • report_incomplete now appears in reviewer prompts and runtime tool lists (#76537).
    • Workflow and run names are serialized as YAML scalars (#76903).
    • Label names longer than 50 characters are rejected at compile time (#76941).
    • Quota exhaustion is handled in daily-AIC accounting and run-info setup (#76583).
    • Declared workflow imports now propagate 404 errors (#76430).

    🔒 Security Hardening 6

    • Go 1.27.4 fixes \GO-2026-6859 (CVE-2026-97054)\
    • Shell injection prevention in maintenance and upgrade workflows (#76951).
    • Symlink traversal and leaf-symlink race protections for step summaries and Markdown fixtures (#76958, #76956).
    • Temporary files hardened across cache commits, MCP shell outputs, and installer logs (#76954).
    • Gateway fallback configuration is withheld from logs (#76952).
    • Daily AIC history fails closed when contradictory (#76804).

    📚 Documentation 3

    • Model-choice guidance now leads with default routing and model: router (#76985).
    • Custom CA trust for the AWF API proxy is documented (#76918).

  48. GitHub Copilot App v1.4.0

    GitHub Copilot App

    Stable

    Released
    13 Nov 2026
    Changes
    146

    Added /every and /schedule slash commands to schedule recurring or one-time work in a session or Project. Choose a default model for new sessions in Settings → Sessions: keep using the latest-used model, or pick a preferred model, reasoning effort, and context tier.

    Key changes

    • Added /every and /schedule slash commands to schedule recurring or one-time work in a session or Project.
    • Choose a default model for new sessions in Settings → Sessions: keep using the latest-used model, or pick a preferred model, reasoning effort, and context tier.
    • Conversation timeline previews now show image and video thumbnails from your messages, and clicking one opens it in the media viewer.
    • Installed skills in Customize are now grouped by source, with a switch to turn a whole group on or off.
    $ gh release view v1.4.0 --repo github/app
    All 146 changes

    Highlights 5

    • Added /every and /schedule slash commands to schedule recurring or one-time work in a session or Project.
    • Choose a default model for new sessions in Settings → Sessions: keep using the latest-used model, or pick a preferred model, reasoning effort, and context tier.
    • Conversation timeline previews now show image and video thumbnails from your messages, and clicking one opens it in the media viewer.
    • Installed skills in Customize are now grouped by source, with a switch to turn a whole group on or off.
    • The Health check now lists installed plugins whose files are missing, with Reinstall or Remove options.

    Added 7

    • Added /every and /schedule slash commands to schedule recurring or one-time work in a session or Project.
    • Choose a default model for new sessions in Settings → Sessions: keep using the latest-used model, or pick a preferred model, reasoning effort, and context tier.
    • Conversation timeline previews now show image and video thumbnails from your messages, and clicking one opens it in the media viewer
    • Quota warnings and organization budget blocks now include a Contact admin link when your organization provides a help page.
    • Right-click the composer microphone button to choose your dictation microphone
    • Session thumbnail menus now include Show in file manager and, for images, Copy image.
    • The Health check now lists installed plugins whose files are missing, with Reinstall or Remove, and a chat shows the same fixes when Copilot skips such a plugin.

    Changed 9

    • Attachments and references in the composer and conversation now share a consistent, subtle blue link style with leading icons, and inline close buttons are replaced by select-then-Delete removal.
    • Conversation history loading and recovery notices now appear as compact centered pills, with a retry button when messages are missing
    • Errors shown after the model repeatedly fails to respond now use a plain-language summary instead of raw network details, with the full text still available in the expandable details.
    • GitHub pull request and issue links inside pages and HTML artifacts shown in the Browser Canvas now open in the app on macOS, Windows, and Linux
    • Installed skills in Customize are now grouped by source (plugin, personal directory, repository, or built-in), with a switch to turn a whole group on or off
    • Repository dashboards with a single native list widget now show their items in the same table layout used by My Work.
    • Session context menus now open linked pull requests inside the app when GitHub 2.0 is enabled, replacing the separate browser PR link while keeping Copy > Pull request. Cloud sessions offer "Open on…" with Web and Mobile destinations.
    • The native runtime is no longer an experiment. The Native Rust runtime wrapper setting has been removed, and an earlier opt-out no longer keeps sessions on Node.
    • The Project Overview now hides groups that have no sessions instead of showing empty headers.

    Fixed 124

    • A background agent's task tab now shows follow-up messages sent to it, not just the original prompt and its replies
    • A Markdown link whose text is three path segments, such as My/path/here, now shows as a link instead of raw Markdown text
    • A new chat started with a skill from the slash menu no longer shows raw reference markup as its title; it now reads as the skill command, such as /every 30m say hello.
    • A newly added MCP server in Customize no longer shows "Connecting…" indefinitely when the runtime never reports a status for it
    • A Project's row in the Sessions sidebar now shows the needs-input indicator when one of its sessions is waiting for you to trust the repository.
    • A reply's quoted numbered list that follows a line of text now looks the same while streaming as after you reopen the chat
    • A repository's Code tab now recognises READMEs written in AsciiDoc, Org and other markups GitHub renders, instead of skipping them or showing a docs folder README in their place.
    • A session created just before the app quit unexpectedly now reopens instead of failing to load its history
    • After editing and resending a prompt with the keyboard, focus now moves to the message box instead of being lost.
    • Arrow keys in the conversation timeline now move exactly one prompt at a time, and the selected prompt matches what the screen reader announces.
    • Automation runs interrupted by closing the app no longer show a duration that includes the time the app was closed
    • Automation runs keep the correct Open as chat or Open as session option after you add or remove the automation's repository
    • Changing a repository's GitHub account now names the account that Copilot usage will actually bill to, including for GitHub Enterprise Server accounts and repositories with a separate Copilot account.
    • Chats whose most recent activity is all sub-agent work no longer open to an empty chat and now show their earlier history
    • Clicking a #number reference to a GitHub discussion in a pull request description now opens the discussion instead of showing a connection error.
    • Clicking a link to a comment on a session's own pull request now stays in the session's pull request tab instead of opening a duplicate tab.
    • Connector errors from the connector proxy now show the real cause, and connectors that need repair offer Disconnect instead of a Reconnect button that did nothing
    • Contents links to a heading that starts or ends with an image (such as a logo or badge) now scroll to that heading in agent replies and the Markdown preview.
    • Creating a GitHub issue follows your selected tool permission mode again: Allow All proceeds without another prompt, Assisted follows the safety review, and Always Ask still asks for approval with the repository, title, and body.
    • Deleting a worktree session now also removes its checkpoint snapshots from the repository instead of leaving them behind.
    • Deleting an agent now returns any repository it added without showing it in the sidebar, so the repository appears in the sidebar again and you can start sessions in it
    • Diff lines containing box-drawing characters, arrows, math symbols, check marks, or Vietnamese text now stay aligned to the monospace column grid, and Vietnamese tone marks render correctly.
    • Dollar signs in issue and pull request descriptions, comments and reviews are no longer turned into math when github.com shows them as plain text, such as shell variables and quoted formulas.
    • Editing an automation that has already run no longer fails to save, and the Workspace picker is now locked once an automation has a run on record.
    • Emoji shortcodes in label names now render as emoji, including GitHub's image emoji, in the timeline, the labels sidebar, the label picker and the metadata toolbar
    • Find in rendered Markdown no longer counts or steps to a match in the hidden "Footnotes" heading that isn't visible on screen.
    • Fixed "Session unavailable" errors when sending the first message in a new session after accepting repository content
    • Fixed /new, /restart-session and /collect-debug-logs staying unavailable in a chat whose session failed to resume, so you can start the chat fresh or save its debug logs.
    • Fixed a question in a cloud or Codespace session staying on screen after the host had already dropped it, which kept the session reporting that it was waiting for input.
    • Fixed long plugin names overlapping the status and Reinstall button in the Health check's missing-plugin rows
    • Fixed My work project field filters showing a percent-encoded field name (such as "privacy%2flegal-review") until the project's fields finished loading.
    • Fixed the app freezing for several seconds when opening the message composer with a long multi-line draft or pasting many short lines.
    • Fixed the app never getting past its splash screen on macOS whose Safari is older than 16.4.
    • Fixed the canvas picker's Custom section staying empty when your user canvases were slow to start up after an update
    • Fixed the conversation shifting slightly when its content changed size after you had scrolled up a little from the bottom.
    • Fixed the conversation timeline intercepting clicks on a code block's Copy button, which jumped to an earlier prompt instead of copying the code.
    • Fixed the Remote index menu and repository settings continuing to show a failed indexing request error after the repository had finished indexing.
    • Fixed the session menu's Branch submenu showing a disabled "From Unavailable" row for sessions on the repository's own checkout
    • Fixed the seventh series' cross markers in Mermaid XY charts rendering as ragged blobs when a color filter is enabled
    • Fixed the terminal not running Git Bash login startup files when the Windows Terminal profile launches it with -li.
    • Fixed transcript text showing through status banners above the composer (session unavailable, session creation errors, failed model or provider switches, and usage warnings) in dark GitHub themes
    • Fixed unanswered review threads in the Changes tab having no Mark as resolved action, so they could only be cleared by prompting the agent again.
    • In Manage sessions, deselecting all after collapsing a repository group now also deselects the sessions inside the collapsed group, so Archive and Delete no longer act on sessions you deselected.
    • Indented code inside a list item, quote or footnote no longer shows stray *, [ or backtick characters while a reply is still streaming
    • Links between nested groups in Mermaid flowcharts and state diagrams are now drawn between their nodes instead of floating away from them
    • Loading older history in a very long chat no longer gets slower with each older page
    • Long pasted text chips that are cut and pasted in the prompt composer are now included when the prompt is sent.
    • Looking up a repository in an organization that requires SAML single sign-on authorization now shows a short error title with the full recovery steps readable, instead of a truncated paragraph.
    • Lowercase issue references like gh-123 in pull request and issue descriptions are now linked, matching github.com.
    • Markdown HTML that is cut off partway through a tag, such as a truncated Dependabot pull request description, now renders normally instead of showing the whole block as raw HTML source.
    • Mermaid class diagrams now show generic types, abstract and static method markers, and accessibility titles correctly instead of drawing them as stray text or extra class boxes
    • Mermaid diagrams now honor a direction set on a subgraph or composite state nested inside another one, instead of drawing it in the chart's direction
    • Mermaid diagrams now show labels as written instead of silently turning asterisks and tildes into bold, italic, or strikethrough text, and Markdown strings no longer display their backticks.
    • Mermaid ER diagrams now render composite keys such as PK, FK, relationships written with word cardinalities, and entity aliases like p[Person] correctly instead of dropping or mis-drawing them.
    • Mermaid flowcharts and state diagrams now draw links correctly into and out of nested groups when a group sets its own direction
    • Mermaid flowcharts that link nodes before grouping them in a subgraph now draw those nodes inside their group instead of leaving the group empty
    • Mermaid flowcharts that use node shape syntax (A@{ shape: circle }) or link ids (A e1@--> B) now render correctly instead of dropping links and showing node ids.
    • Mermaid line charts no longer draw lines that overshoot or dip beyond the data, and horizontal line charts no longer stop after the first point
    • Mermaid sequence diagrams now show participants with spaces in their names, bidirectional arrows, and participant metadata correctly instead of dropping or inventing participants
    • Mermaid XY charts no longer draw bars and line points past the last x-axis category outside the chart
    • Mermaid XY charts now label each value-axis gridline distinctly and draw all-negative bars inside the plot
    • Model providers can no longer be added or used when your organization disables Bring Your Own Key; settings now explain the policy.
    • New chats now get a generated title on accounts whose model list has no enabled lightweight model, instead of keeping the start of the first prompt as the title
    • New chats that start on the default model no longer show a false "Model changed" row above the first reply.
    • New sessions no longer fail to start when a leftover packed-refs.lock file is in the repository, and removing a worktree on a network share, such as a WSL checkout, no longer fails.
    • NVDA no longer announces the prompt composer's placeholder instructions twice
    • On macOS, pressing Option+Return in a permission prompt's "tell Copilot what to do instead" box now starts a new line instead of sending the denial immediately.
    • On the Health check page, "Share as gist" and "Export" no longer lose keyboard focus while they run, so you can press Enter again to retry after a failure
    • On Windows, repositories that use VFS for Git (GVFS) now use a compatible VFS-enabled Git, with clear installation guidance when one isn't found
    • On Windows, the terminal now opens your Windows Terminal default profile when it is set by profile name or by a GUID in a different letter case.
    • On-device Windows ML models now have an output limit, so a looping reply no longer streams on for tens of minutes until the context window fills.
    • Opening a ghapp:// link to a GitHub comment on an issue or pull request now scrolls to and focuses that comment.
    • Opening a large source file in a repository's Code tab no longer freezes the window when its syntax colours appear
    • Opening Settings with the keyboard shortcut while another dialog is open now shows Settings on top and gives it focus, instead of opening it hidden underneath
    • Pasting a collapsed long-text chip (such as "300 lines") copied from one prompt box into another now attaches it, so it is sent with your message
    • Pasting a GHE.com pull request URL into Create from now finds the pull request instead of reporting an invalid branch name
    • Pasting a GitHub comment link into Quick Open now opens the issue or pull request at that comment instead of at the top.
    • Pasting a long log into a comment box no longer freezes the window for a noticeable time
    • Pasting a Markdown link to a GitHub pull request, issue, repository or project into the message box no longer breaks the link.
    • Pasting an indented snippet with list-style lines (such as YAML) into the message box no longer turns it into a bullet list or splits it when sent.
    • Pressing Tab in a diff with several changed files now follows each file's header and its expand-lines buttons in visual order, instead of visiting every file header first and then jumping back up to the first file's expand buttons
    • Pressing Tab on a focused sidebar session row now moves into its session summary immediately instead of skipping past it, and Escape cancels a summary that is still waiting to appear
    • Quick Open now lists matching issues and pull requests that were previously hidden when they ranked below the first eight search results.
    • Quick Open now shows an error when the GitHub search for pull requests or issues fails, instead of reporting that nothing was found
    • Quick Open's Recent group now lists pull requests and issues from other people's repositories that you opened from search.
    • Re-opening a large file edit in a conversation no longer briefly freezes the app while its code gets syntax colouring
    • Replies that quote a long passage in a blockquote now stream smoothly instead of slowing down as the quote grows
    • Repository Pull requests and Issues tabs now show the SAML single sign-on authorization message instead of "Nothing here" when the organization requires SSO you have not authorized
    • Restoring a session with many open canvases no longer flashes the right panel through each canvas in turn; your selected tab stays put.
    • Retrying or recreating a session's worktree no longer deletes an existing checkout that holds your work, and worktree setup no longer removes another session's checkout
    • Running /clear, /new, or /reset in a chat started from Home now keeps the cleared chat open instead of returning to Home and leaving an empty "New session" in the sidebar.
    • Screen readers now announce attachment-only prompts in the conversation timeline by their attachment names instead of just "Prompt:"
    • Searching Settings for MCP servers, plugins or skills now shows results that open the matching list in Customize
    • Sending a message that has a reference, attachment or inspected element no longer moves a list item's second paragraph, code block or rule out of its list.
    • Sessions whose Copilot CLI takes more than 60 seconds to start, for example while starting many MCP servers, now open once startup finishes instead of failing to reconnect on every attempt
    • Settings now indicates when your preferred model for new sessions is no longer available and that new sessions use the default model instead.
    • Slash commands such as /new, /clear, /reset, /restart-session and /collect-debug-logs now work in a chat whose session is unavailable, so you can start a fresh session from there
    • Slash commands typed with different capitalization, such as /Clear or /Permissions show, now run instead of being sent to Copilot as a prompt.
    • SSO authorization errors now offer host-specific SSO sign-in guidance and alternative app or account authorization routes, with administrator escalation, instead of pointing to an Applications page where the app may not appear.
    • State diagrams in Markdown replies now draw transitions that use Mermaid's :::class shorthand correctly, without stray labels or missing end states, and no longer show accessibility title and description lines as extra states
    • Tab rows keep scrolling the selected or focused tab into view after you drag the window by an empty part of the row
    • The "Preparing worktree" step no longer keeps animating after a new worktree session fails to start.
    • The Agents overview in a repository's Code tab now counts skills from .agents/skills and .claude/skills and custom agents from .claude/agents and any Markdown file in .github/agents, and the chips open the folder that holds them.
    • The automation run menu now describes a custom CRON schedule in words instead of showing "Repeats: CRON".
    • The Automations skills list and / skill suggestions now include personal skills from ~/.agents/skills and from folders listed under skillDirectories in ~/.copilot/settings.json.
    • The Browser tab toolbar no longer clips or hides its address field and buttons in narrow panels; controls now wrap to a second row and stay reachable.
    • The Changes diff no longer freezes while inline review threads load or when the panel is resized
    • The Computer Use switch in Settings now shows "Enabling…" or "Disabling…" progress while the change applies, and no longer flashes a temporary "Turn on Computer Use" message when it finishes.
    • The delete session dialog no longer adds text when you check "Also delete nested sessions", and its button shows how many sessions will be deleted.
    • The GitHub account chooser in the Clone repository dialog is now a labeled radio group, so screen readers announce which account is selected and arrow keys move the choice.
    • The Health check Logs header no longer overlaps its description or cuts off the Level filter in a narrow window
    • The keyboard focus ring on the conversation timeline is now fully visible and has enough contrast
    • The Project filter in My work now shows the project's name instead of its owner and number after you search for a project or reopen a saved filter.
    • The pull request header's actions now wrap instead of being cut off when the pane is narrow.
    • The read-only frontmatter table in Markdown files now shows lists and maps with correct indentation instead of nesting every entry after the first.
    • The repository sidebar no longer shows a raw 403 error and a Retry button for contributors on very large repositories like torvalds/linux
    • Typing /yolo or /allow-all-tools without a value now turns on Approve all instead of showing a "Choose a value" error.
    • Typing a file name after @ in the composer no longer freezes the app in workspaces with tens of thousands of files.
    • When a message can't be sent because the Copilot CLI or the session's folder is missing, the error now names the missing path instead of only showing "No such file or directory"
    • When a repository you added finishes cloning after you moved to Home or another session, the app no longer takes you away from that screen and the prompt you were writing stays in view.
    • When a request to your own model provider fails after several retries, the error now says your model provider didn't respond instead of blaming GitHub Copilot.
    • When a slash command is refused before it runs, such as /every with the schedule skill turned off, the text you typed now returns to the message box instead of being lost.
    • When an agent opens the same issue again while its first session is still setting up, it now gets that session back instead of starting a second one for the same issue.
    • Wrapped diff lines containing Hebrew, Arabic, Thai or emoji text no longer cut off the end of the line

    Removed 1

    • Removed the "Skill folders" dropdown next to Add in the Skills view of Customize
    Source: github/appTag: v1.4.0 Changelog Release notes →

  49. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.33-preview.0

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Prerelease

    Released
    13 Nov 2026
    Changes
    68

    Fixed a CLI issue where the /usage activity graph wrapped in narrow terminals; it now fits correctly. The permissionprompt notification hook no longer runs for a permission request that Assisted Permissions approves without asking. Fix .NET shell authentication cancellation cleanup callbacks being lost when a request finishes before queued notifications run.

    Key changes

    • Fixed a CLI issue where the /usage activity graph wrapped in narrow terminals; it now fits correctly.
    • The permission_prompt notification hook no longer runs for a permission request that Assisted Permissions approves without asking.
    • Fix .NET shell authentication cancellation cleanup callbacks being lost when a request finishes before queued notifications run.
    • Node.js: start() after a lost TCP connection now terminates the runtime process the client spawned before starting a new one, so stop() no longer leaves the old runtime running.
    $ gh release view v1.0.33-preview.0 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 68 changes

    Changes 68

    • Fixed a CLI issue where the /usage activity graph wrapped in narrow terminals; it now fits correctly.
    • The permission_prompt notification hook no longer runs for a permission request that Assisted Permissions approves without asking.
    • Fix .NET shell authentication cancellation cleanup callbacks being lost when a request finishes before queued notifications run.
    • Node.js: start() after a lost TCP connection now terminates the runtime process the client spawned before starting a new one, so stop() no longer leaves the old runtime running.
    • session.workflow.run no longer fails when a SessionFs SQLite provider commits the run but reports postCommitAmbiguous; the committed run starts.
    • .NET: ListSessionsAsync now applies SessionListFilter.WorkingDirectory instead of returning sessions from every directory.
    • Improved quota accuracy by refreshing plan quota from the Copilot user in /usage and account.getQuota.
    • Fixed a runtime stability issue where the SDK host could abort if its standard error stream was closed.
    • Marketplace browse results include managedDesiredEnabled for plugins controlled by managed settings; installing a plugin blocked by managed settings is refused with error data code managed_policy_blocked.
    • Go: Ping, GetStatus, GetAuthStatus, ListModels and RuntimePort no longer data-race a concurrent Start, Stop or ForceStop; during Start the first four wait for it to finish.
    • Managed Shell(...), Bash(...), and PowerShell(...) permission rules accept JavaScript regular expressions written as /pattern/flags, including patterns that contain ). A regular expression that runs longer than 1 second, cannot start within 1 second because too many others are running, or ignores case in a way that cannot be matched as JavaScript matches it counts as a match for deny and ask rules and does not approve the command for allow rules.
    • Behavior change: a managed shell rule argument written as /pattern/flags is now a regular expression, except a command path such as Shell(/usr/bin/id) or an invalid regular expression, which are read as literal text and get a managedSettings.validate warning.
    • Add source skill install and removal APIs across all SDK languages.
    • .NET: A call that waits for another caller's StartAsync to finish now stops when its own CancellationToken is cancelled.
    • Plugin list entries now include team: true when the signed-in account's GitHub Team assigns the plugin.
    • Add non-blocking workflow admission, workflow-scoped custom agents, and per-agent deadlines to Dynamic Workflows.
    • Fixed shell tool results and telemetry to report when attached shells were stopped by session.abort(), agent termination, sandbox changes, or provider policy stops instead of incorrectly attributing them to stop_bash. Shell termination behavior is unchanged.
    • Go: ResumeSession and DeleteSession no longer race a concurrent Start under the Go race detector.
    • Sandboxed local MCP initialization errors now identify the refused filesystem operation when a Node server crashes with its default stack trace.
    • Report enterprise MCP policy blocks instead of intentional server stops for MCP App requests.
    • Workspace MCP servers (.mcp.json, .github/mcp.json) with a relative cwd now start in that path under the directory holding the config file, instead of under the process working directory.
    • session.mcp.getToolTokenBreakdown and session.tools.getCurrentMetadata now report tools that generic client tool search left out of the last request as deferred, instead of counting them as sent in full.
    • Fixed Windows sandbox path handling to prevent PATH and tool environment entries with drive-like components from granting unintended read access to drive roots or session-directory ancestors.
    • Steered messages sent with mode immediate now include hasSubmittedTask on their user.message event, like other new user messages.
    • Node.js: start() called after the runtime exited now starts a new runtime right away, even when a process the runtime started still holds its output open, instead of returning while the client stays on the exited runtime.
    • Java, Python, and Rust now honor COPILOT_CLI_PATH without silently substituting another runtime when the selected installation is invalid.
    • Go: Client.Start called after the runtime exited now starts a new runtime even when the old connection has not finished closing, instead of returning nil and leaving the client on the exited runtime.
    • Python: start() called after a request failed because the connection to the runtime was lost now starts a new connection instead of returning while the client is still on the closed one.
    • session.history.rewind now works on sessions stored through a session filesystem provider, and on sessions created with configDirectory; it used to fail with truncation-failed.
    • Model-switch messages and compaction confirmations now display preview and hidden models as “Hidden Model N” when streamer mode is enabled.
    • excludedTools that is not an array of strings is now rejected with an error instead of making every subagent of the session fail.
    • Node.js: stop() and forceStop() called while start() is still connecting over TCP now end that connect right away, so start() rejects and stop() returns at once instead of waiting up to 10 seconds for the connect timeout.
    • .NET: CopilotClient.RuntimePort returns null after StopAsync, ForceStopAsync or a failed StartAsync of a runtime the client started, instead of the stopped runtime's port. A client of an external runtime keeps its configured port.
    • Added experimental sessions.hasEvents and shell.buildInteractiveEnvironment methods across all six SDKs, with Node.js payload types available from the package root.
    • Java RPC diagnostics now redact hostEnvironment and returned environment fields without changing request or response contents.
    • Generated Rust Debug, Python repr, and Java toString omit interactive-shell environment maps without changing wire values.
    • Fixed late cancellation of a completed user-requested shell command incorrectly aborting the next command that reuses its request ID.
    • Fixed excessive memory use in session.workspaces.diff for large untracked files; oversized files remain marked as truncated.
    • Workspace diffs now show untracked symlinks by their target path without opening the target, avoiding hangs and unintended reads outside the repository.
    • Workspace diffs now preserve executable permissions in diff headers for untracked files.
    • Go and Python: Start/start() called after the stdio runtime exited now starts a new runtime, even when a process the runtime started still holds its output open, instead of returning while the client stays on the exited runtime.
    • Node.js, Python: ping, getStatus, getAuthStatus and listModels called while start() is running now wait for it and then use the new connection, or fail with the start's error, instead of failing with Client not connected or sending their request before the connection handshake.
    • .NET and Java: StartAsync()/start() after the runtime process exits now starts a new runtime instead of succeeding on the dead connection.
    • .NET: StartServerAsync, RestartServerAsync and Config.AddAsync/UpdateAsync accept McpStdioServerConfig and McpHttpServerConfig with unset optional fields again, instead of failing with timeout: Expected integer.
    • Go: Client.RuntimePort returns 0 after a Start that fails and stops the runtime the client started, instead of that runtime's port. A URIConnection client keeps its configured port.
    • Fixed userPromptSubmitted hooks so additionalContext from every hook, including extensions that join a session, reaches the model in run order instead of only the last hook's.
    • Built-in CLI documentation now includes --allow-tool rule examples, clarifies that rules apply only to the current run, and points to the full permission syntax.
    • .NET: a client that spawns its runtime now starts the bundled runtime when COPILOT_CLI_PATH is set to an empty value, instead of failing with "Cannot start process because a file name has not been provided".
    • Fixed session.mcp.oauth.probe to report needs-auth instead of failed when a Streamable HTTP MCP server returns 401 with empty or whitespace-only WWW-Authenticate headers.
    • SDK clients can create sessions on AHP hosts launched with --host-allow-session-creation alongside --host-ahp or --host-environment, without changing saved settings.
    • Child system notifications preserve their subagent attribution in session event streams.
    • Hosted programmatic tool calling supports suffixed OpenAI model IDs.
    • Malformed config.json files are now preserved instead of overwritten during startup or state updates. Sessions warn and continue without the saved state until the file is fixed.
    • On macOS, sessions that allow the temp directory now also allow the user's own files under /tmp without a path permission request.
    • Steered messages sent with mode immediate now carry the running turn's parentAgentTaskId on their user.message event, like the turn's first message.
    • Fixed session.workspaces.diff returning garbled added lines for untracked binary files; it now returns a binary-file notice instead.
    • A waiting session.eventLog.read no longer spins until its deadline after compaction or a history rewrite, and no longer skips events emitted after compaction removed earlier events.
    • Fixed session.workspaces.diff to list copied files as added under their new names when Git copy detection is enabled, without duplicating source entries or including source edits in copy patches.
    • Fixed session.workspaces.diff omitting the last listed file when its name ends in a space.
    • Improved runtime behavior so steer requests sent at the end of a turn are processed immediately instead of waiting behind background agent work.
    • An Auto session whose token renewal moves to another model continues the turn on that model instead of failing.
    • When ASYNC_SUBAGENTS is enabled, the task tool takes a wait timeout instead of a sync/background mode, and task agents stay reusable for follow-up messages.
    • plugins.enable, plugins.disable, plugins.update and plugins.uninstall now fail with the file path when config.json cannot be parsed, instead of reporting no change or that the plugin is not installed.
    • Deleting a session while one of its client tool handlers is running now publishes external_tool.completed for the outstanding request, so the handler's cancellation signal fires, as it does for abort.
    • Fixed an issue where a failed skills reload removed all SDK-provided skills.
    • Fixed OAuth sign-in for remote MCP servers through proxies that require Kerberos (Negotiate) authentication.
    • Protected local sessions can create, read and edit eligible extension sources while enforcing filesystem restrictions; provider and LSP permissions remain unchanged.
    • Rewind points, rewind previews and conversation-and-files rewinds no longer count or report a file that the rewound turns left unchanged.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.33-preview.0 Changelog Release notes →

  50. GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.111-0

    GitHub Copilot CLI

    Prerelease

    Released
    13 Nov 2026
    Changes
    121

    Add regular expression support to enterprise-managed Shell, Bash, and PowerShell permission rules. Add --host-allow-session-creation to let remote clients create sessions on CLI hosts for one launch without changing saved settings. Show organization support links in policy guidance and managed settings notices.

    Key changes

    • Add regular expression support to enterprise-managed Shell, Bash, and PowerShell permission rules

    $ gh release view v1.0.111-0 --repo github/copilot-cli
    All 121 changes

    Added 2

    • Add regular expression support to enterprise-managed Shell, Bash, and PowerShell permission rules
    • Add --host-allow-session-creation to let remote clients create sessions on CLI hosts for one launch without changing saved settings

    Improved 2

    • Show organization support links in policy guidance and managed settings notices
    • Indexed search becomes available sooner after restarting, and its enabled notice appears only when the index can serve searches.
