    • Refresh /usage premium request usage so percentages stay current.
    • Prevent duplicate MCP OAuth reconnects and keep servers in needs-auth after canceled authorization
    • Markdown tables containing a wide symbol followed by the text variation selector, such as ⌛︎, render with correctly aligned rows
    • The footer.showCodeChanges setting description now says it shows the lines added and removed by Copilot's file edits in this session, not pending changes
    • The /usage activity graph now fits narrow terminals by showing fewer weeks, instead of wrapping every day row in two
    • Shell output and custom status lines display correctly when terminal control sequences appear, without applying unintended text styles
    • /rewind with Conversation + files no longer counts, lists or reports as restored a file that later turns had already put back or deleted again
    • Interactive /plugin marketplace commands find repository-local marketplaces when the CLI starts in a subdirectory
    • Keep selection labels readable and rows aligned in /environments when using --screen-reader
    • /skills get without a skill name and the /mcp usage text name the get and remove verbs instead of the retired info and delete
    • /diff shows a clear notice for binary files instead of garbled text or an empty pane
    • The /usage activity graph hides its legend in narrow panes to prevent it from wrapping onto extra lines
    • The $ shell shortcut reports launch failures once with a clear reason, including when Ctrl+G opens the editor at the same time.
    • /mcp search installs registry servers with URL variables using the values you enter
    • Custom status lines render terminal colors and formatting correctly, without stray characters after color resets.
    • Hook approval dialogs show control characters in tool names and arguments as visible text instead of hiding or restyling them
    • /session delete-all, /session prune, and /session delete preserve sessions running in the background in the same window
    • Text that fits on one row stays on one row after resizing the terminal
    • In /workflows, a run's Agents list no longer runs off the bottom of a short terminal: the selected agent stays on screen, and a long phase title stays on one row
    • copilot plugin enable, disable, update and uninstall now fail and name config.json when it cannot be parsed, instead of reporting success without a change or that the plugin is not installed
    • --no-color preserves text styling while disabling colors, even when FORCE_COLOR is set
    • Pasted image paths attach correctly when you press Enter immediately after pasting in terminals that mark pasted input
    • Keep the selected /share action visible when navigation keys cannot move the selection in short terminals
    • MCP forms show validation errors immediately for answers edited in an external editor with Ctrl+G
    • Running copilot --continue with no previous session shows the welcome header and Getting started box.
    • Keep the Sessions tab responsive when dialogs open during navigation, and show pending dialogs where they can be answered
    • Keep the highlighted confirmation option visible in the Sessions tab and /environments on short terminals
    • Keep the /theme picker's title and border on screen in narrow terminals and beside the docked Sessions sidebar, dropping the preview instead
    • The /share screen keeps the selected action visible in narrow terminals
    • /ask and /btw show answers correctly beside the Sessions sidebar in narrow terminals
    • Keep the /tasks title and borders visible when the task list is longer than the terminal can display
    • copilot -p "/compact" --silent no longer prints the compaction result line to stdout, so --silent output stays limited to the agent's response
    • Keep the prompt, tab bar, and status line visible when typing a multi-line draft during the startup animation on short terminals
    • /diff shows staged renames under their new names, including edits made while renaming
    • With experimental dynamic workflows, a workflow's own agent can no longer start or resume workflow runs, so a workflow can no longer start copies of itself without limit when all tools are allowed.
    • With the high-contrast theme on a 16 or 256-colour terminal, the Sessions tab shows the status icon of the selected row instead of drawing it blue on blue
    • Follow-ups typed while the agent is working now run in the order they were typed; one that reached the session between two turns is no longer overtaken by follow-ups typed after it.
    • The /usage activity graph counts only the prompts you typed, not sub-agent or autopilot prompts, and its message total matches the days the graph draws
    • Pasted escape sequences no longer change text colours or hide text in search fields
    • copilot -p with --trust-folder, run from a subdirectory of a repository, now warns that the hooks at the repository root were not loaded and says how to load them
    • Custom status lines display non-ASCII characters correctly even when commands write them in pieces
    • Copying inline code from wrapped rows after resizing the terminal no longer includes extra non-breaking spaces.
    • Queued slash commands now show an error when they fail instead of disappearing silently
    • Prompts sent as a turn finishes now run without waiting for background agents to complete
    • Dragging the sessions divider or scrollbar now ends cleanly when the left mouse button is no longer held.
    • Allow your own scratch files under /tmp on macOS without path permission prompts unless --disallow-temp-dir is set
    • Re-attaching an image or document after switching models or compacting a session sends its content to the model
    • Show an error when /update cannot download a release instead of leaving the download progress message indefinitely
    • Sessions started with /new or from the Sessions tab can be controlled from GitHub when remote sessions are enabled
    • Expand ${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT} in plugin hook working directories and environment values
    • Push-to-talk preserves dictated text when held Space key repeats pause and resume
    • OAuth sign-in for remote MCP servers works through proxies that require Kerberos (Negotiate) authentication
    • Show permission prompts, questions, and confirmations directly in the sub-agent view so you can respond without leaving it
    • Keep text after terminal control sequences visible in labels and output, and hide embedded image data
    • Search in /skills, /mcp, and /plugin matches visible text instead of words hidden inside terminal escape sequences
    • Clear the previous profile's routed model from the footer and custom status line when switching Copilot Fusion profiles
    • Prevent @ file mentions and /sandbox path completion from selecting outdated suggestions when typing quickly
    • The /sandbox Credentials tab counts masked environment variables separately from unmasked suggestions
    • /resume keeps session rows aligned and columns visible with --screen-reader, and announces unread status once
    • Show all rows of wrapped Japanese, Chinese, and Korean text without clipping the last row or leaving extra blank rows
    • Resizing the terminal during a text-selection drag preserves the clipboard instead of copying empty lines or unhighlighted text
    • Keep the @ file picker up to date when ignore files change above the working directory
    • Autopilot confirmation hides Assisted Permissions when disabled by administrator policy and explains why they are unavailable.
    • Keep /config view tabs and the selected view readable in screen-reader mode on narrow terminals
    • Exiting the CLI on macOS and Linux now stops attached background shells even when they ignore termination signals.
    • Sandboxed MCP startup errors identify refused filesystem operations even when the server prints a stack trace
    • /mcp token counts exclude tools deferred by client-side tool search
    • Preserve freshly pasted text when stashing or opening the external editor, and prevent Ctrl+D from exiting while a paste is pending
    • Prevent the # issue and pull request picker from selecting outdated results when typing quickly
    • /plugin Details shows repository-local plugins without a User scope label and keeps versions separate from descriptions
    • Workspace MCP servers resolve relative working directories from their config's directory level, including after /cd or when launching from a subdirectory
    • /mcp delete removes a server without restarting other connected MCP servers
    • Keep Sessions sidebar and shell shortcut hints readable in narrow terminals by hiding hints that do not fit
    • Queued Copilot Fusion routing-profile changes show an acknowledgement when the current turn ends, before the next prompt.
    • Keep /diff responsive with large untracked files and show untracked symlinks by their target paths instead of their contents
    • HTML exports and rich-text copies preserve generic types and placeholders written in angle brackets, such as Vec<String> and <file>
    • Allow image generation when settings.json is empty or contains only whitespace
    • Keep the current location highlighted and announced to screen readers in narrow /config views while the area list has focus.
    • Installing MCP servers from the registry with optional fields left blank now preserves server defaults instead of saving placeholder text
    • Show agent IDs in /subagents when custom agents share a name, so you can tell which agent you configure
    • Keep /ask and /btw question headers in plain text when pasting colored terminal output or control characters
    • Keep the terminal's own colors in editors opened with Ctrl+G and shells opened with $ when the CLI's theme changes
    • MCP registry installs preserve npm launch arguments when the server already includes an install confirmation flag
    • Keep text typed immediately after a paste separate, so pasted image paths attach correctly and text after long pastes remains editable
    • Keep /config view tabs intact and the selected area visible on narrow terminals
    • Editor shortcuts stay inactive while the CLI exits, keeping the terminal ready for the shell
    • Show MCP servers that return an empty authentication challenge in the /mcp auth picker
    • Pasting text into Ctrl+R history search ignores escape sequences so matches, colors, and cursor placement stay correct
    • Pasting colored text into /plugin, /skills, and /mcp search matches the visible text and preserves dashboard colors
    • Emoji stay readable under the cursor in /model search, and long /diff search queries scroll on one line
    • Long search queries in the Sessions tab and /resume wrap correctly and keep the cursor aligned with typed text.
    • /diff lists copied files correctly when Git copy detection is enabled and preserves files whose names end in spaces
    • Keep Copilot model access when account lookups are rate-limited
    • Keep the exit status of a collapsed failed shell row whole in narrow terminals, and show as much of the command description as fits beside it
    • Deleting a session through the SDK while one of its client tools is running now cancels that tool's handler, instead of leaving it running after the session is gone.
    • A GITHUB_ASKPASS helper that never answers no longer stalls startup for over five minutes; sign-in now fails after one helper timeout
    • After /code hands a session off to VS Code, resuming that session in the same window and switching back no longer brings back the notice that it is open in VS Code Chat
    • Keep Windows drive letters with their paths when wrapping command previews in approval dialogs
    • A config.json that cannot be read, such as one with an extra closing brace or one cut short by an interrupted write, is no longer replaced at startup by a file holding only firstLaunchAt; its trusted folders, plugins, marketplaces and other saved state stay in the file
    • MCP enable/disable and plugin commands work when settings.json is empty
    • A remote MCP server that refuses or closes the first connection at session start, for example while it is still starting, is retried as planned instead of staying failed for the rest of the session
    • With sidebar.hoverFocus off and sidebar.showCloseButton on, moving the mouse over a Sessions sidebar card no longer moves the selection onto it
    • Copying an answer with the mouse keeps the blank lines inside blockquotes
    • The "Compacting conversation history" counter keeps counting from when the compaction started after the queue manager is opened and closed, instead of restarting at 0
    • A plugin whose plugin.json location holds a named pipe or a link to a device such as /dev/zero no longer hangs or exhausts memory when skills, prompts or plugin lists load it; the file is skipped like an unreadable manifest
    • Shell tool results no longer keep terminal escape sequences or hyperlink targets when a sequence is split across two reads of the command's output, as happens with coloured output larger than one read
    • After /compact, the runtime no longer keeps a CPU core busy until the next event, and the session's live event stream no longer skips events that arrive after a compaction removed earlier ones
    • A permission_prompt notification hook no longer runs for a request that Assisted Permissions approves without asking
    • Adding or changing a repository's GitHub remote while the CLI is running is now picked up straight away, so /pr no longer keeps saying the repository is not connected to GitHub until the CLI restarts.
    • When an extension fails to load, its log now shows the full error report, including the file and line of a syntax error, the stack trace and any cause, instead of a single line.
    • The Sessions sidebar row of the session you are in shows it working for the whole of a running turn, and screen readers hear "status working" instead of "status done"
    • With Auto selected, the footer's context percentage and the status line's displayed_context_limit now use the window of the model Auto routed to, matching /context, instead of a fixed 200,000 tokens
    • The standalone CLI now re-extracts its cached package when cli-native.node has gone missing from it, instead of failing on every start with Native addon "cli-native" not found
    • A workflow run that a session filesystem SQLite provider committed but reported as postCommitAmbiguous now starts, instead of failing and leaving a pending run that cannot be cancelled or resumed
    • An extension prompt asking for many sensitive environment variables on a short terminal now keeps the first listed name and the count of the rest on screen instead of scrolling every name out of view
    • The CLI's selection copies inline code and color swatches without decorative padding when their background color is shown
    • Context from multiple userPromptSubmitted hooks now reaches the model instead of only the last hook's context

  51. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.32

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Stable

    Released
    12 Nov 2026
    Changes
    60

    Fix managed-account changes stalling while live extensions restart and rejoin the session. Copilot SDKs can now answer sudo, SSH, and Git password prompts from commands the agent runs, through a new shell authentication handler. Answers go only to the program that asked.

    Key changes

    • Fix managed-account changes stalling while live extensions restart and rejoin the session.
    • Copilot SDKs can now answer sudo, SSH, and Git password prompts from commands the agent runs, through a new shell authentication handler. Answers go only to the program that asked.
    • Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, Rust: A request handler no longer keeps memory for each response the runtime cancels after the handler has finished it, such as a response rejected for exceeding the response size limit.
    • Adding a marketplace from a two-segment relative or home path such as ./name, ../name or ~/name now adds the local directory instead of cloning a GitHub repository
    $ gh release view v1.0.32 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 60 changes

    Changes 60

    • Fix managed-account changes stalling while live extensions restart and rejoin the session.
    • Copilot SDKs can now answer sudo, SSH, and Git password prompts from commands the agent runs, through a new shell authentication handler. Answers go only to the program that asked.
    • Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, Rust: A request handler no longer keeps memory for each response the runtime cancels after the handler has finished it, such as a response rejected for exceeding the response size limit.
    • Adding a marketplace from a two-segment relative or home path such as ./name, ../name or ~/name now adds the local directory instead of cloning a GitHub repository
    • Ending a session with disconnect, deleteSession or client stop now stops the background shell commands it started without detach, instead of leaving them running after the runtime exits.
    • Forward supplied SDK correlation IDs to Memory requests, preserving replacements on session resume.
    • .NET: Fix the manual tool-resume sample build by using the permission-decision factory with a scoped experimental-API suppression.
    • mcp.config.remove now deletes a user MCP config entry that fails validation instead of reporting that the server was not found
    • Fixed MCP servers restarting when a session shuts down while a connection is completing.
    • Entra-derived Loki account IDs remain stable across endpoint and display-name changes.
    • session.schedule.addCron now rejects cron expressions with a seconds or year field, matching its 5-field contract, and reports an unknown time zone by name instead of as an invalid cron expression.
    • A synchronous bash tool call killed by a sandbox configuration change now fails with an explicit error instead of reporting an empty success.
    • Fixed an issue where /every and /after prompts with natural-language times could lose line breaks and indentation.
    • session.shell.exec now runs a command with a relative cwd under the session working directory instead of the runtime process's directory.
    • Session AI-credit limits now show the model a dollar cost meter after each successful tool call instead of a per-call countdown, and interactive clients with a session-limits listener are offered a top-up at 90% of the limit, before tools are disabled.
    • Preserved graceful shutdown during managed SDK bootstrap.
    • Fix custom agents losing delegation-only tools when availableTools and defaultAgent.excludedTools are combined.
    • session.tools.getCurrentMetadata and session.mcp.getToolTokenBreakdown no longer report a disabled MCP server's tools after a model request.
    • session.metadata.getWorkingDirectoryContext and the session.lsp methods now resolve a relative cwd, workingDirectory or gitRoot under the session working directory instead of the runtime process's directory.
    • A local MCP server reply with a lone UTF-16 surrogate escape is now read with a replacement character instead of timing out.
    • Sandboxed commands reject explicitly denied launch directories before enforcing execution on all supported operating systems.
    • Adds Gemini 4 Carbon model metadata with low, medium, and high reasoning efforts and medium as the default.
    • session.options.update now applies capi.enableWebSocketResponses, so a live session can switch to the HTTP Responses transport.
    • Live plugins now use consistent marketplace precedence and reject user-global toggles for repository-controlled entries.
    • SDKs accept the CLI's Copilot Fusion names: model: "fusion" with a new fusionTier (standard, high, max) on session options and setModel, plus setFusionTier.
    • Cancelling a running dynamic workflow run now ends it cancelled even when a pause reaches the same attempt before or after the cancel.
    • Session usage and model-call failure events can now report /interactions as the API endpoint, for Gemini models served over the native Gemini Interactions API.
    • Added JSON-RPC HTTP APIs with text, streaming, and caller-owned file response modes.
    • skill.invoked events from the skill tool, web_fetch URL permission requests, and file write prompt requests now omit absent optional fields instead of sending null, and no longer include an internal routing field, so they match the session events schema.
    • Fix MCP client attribution to use the calling application's identity and refresh it on reconnect.
    • Custom Windows-convention session filesystem providers support application-configured UNC paths, including additional directories and resume working directories.
    • When an enabled installed plugin's files are missing, sessions now start their other extensions and emit a plugin_activation session warning naming the plugin, instead of failing extension startup or resume.
    • Added an experimental authenticateBasic callback to the network client option, which supplies credentials when a proxy asks for Basic authentication.
    • Respect managed plugin policy when selecting or restoring a custom agent.
    • BYOK providers accept type: "google" to use Google's native Gemini Interactions API (x-goog-api-key auth).
    • fetch.send and fetch.read now report a timeoutMs or readTimeoutMs expiry during a request as FetchTransportErrorData kind "timeout" instead of "request" ("tunnel" through a Negotiate proxy).
    • A postToolUse hook that returns only textResultForLlm for a shell result now also changes that result's detailedContent, so a redaction reaches what clients display.
    • Add runtime-owned IDE endpoints through existing MCP lifecycle methods, MCP tool calls, live IDE state, and ordinary session events.
    • Preserve required serializer nulls, reuse canonical Python and Java event types, and dispose disconnected Python and Go owners before reconnect.
    • Every send blocked by a session AI-credit limit now reports the block, and in non-interactive sessions each blocked sendAndWait rejects with the session limit error instead of only the first; raising the limit with session.options.update re-arms the exhausted warning.
    • Requesting a fusionTier for a BYOK provider's model named fusion now fails with an error that names fusionTier instead of autoTier.
    • Use compatible editing tools and model-specific token and reasoning defaults for additional BYOK model names, including GPT-4o.
    • Tool completion events for a tool that sets no session log, such as grep and glob, now carry detailedContent without a postToolUse hook's additionalContext; the model text in content still includes it.
    • includedBuiltinAgents or excludedBuiltinAgents with a non-string entry is now rejected with an error instead of leaving a session whose every send fails.
    • disabledMcpServers with a non-string entry is now rejected with an error instead of silently starting every disabled MCP server.
    • session.history.truncate on a resumed session no longer lets the next prompt write the removed resume record back to the session log.
    • session.metadata.contextInfo and session.metadata.getContextAttribution return null after a session is resumed until its tools initialize, instead of a measurement that leaves out the built-in tools.
    • Go: calling Start again after the runtime process exits now retires the sessions of the lost connection, so a SendAndWait still waiting on one of them fails immediately and Stop no longer reports errors for them.
    • Update the Java SDK's Jackson dependencies to 2.23.
    • mcp.config.add and mcp.config.update no longer replace an mcp-config.json entry that is skipped as invalid; they return an error that says to remove it first.
    • A tool call no longer hangs when the host removes that tool with setTools while the call waits for permission; the call fails with a tool-unavailable result and the turn finishes.
    • Sandboxed command hook and local MCP initialization errors can identify a filesystem operation reported by the process; hook errors can also identify a blocked proxy connection.
    • Fix Java in-process runtime cleanup when startup is interrupted.
    • Report a person's answers to ask_user, user-input, plan-review and elicitation prompts with the same decisionContext label permission answers use (Node.js createAttributedResult, Python create_attributed_result, Rust AttributedResult, Go OnAttributed*Request handlers, and a DecisionContext on the .NET and Java handler results); the runtime accepts it only from the session's owning connection.
    • Copilot Connectors that an SDK host supplies are no longer blocked by an organization's "Registry only" MCP registry policy; managed allow and deny lists still apply.
    • With tool search on, session.tools.getCurrentMetadata and session.mcp.getToolTokenBreakdown now report the deferral the next request will use after the tool set changes, instead of the last request's.
    • Sessions now accept new messages after a host event acknowledgement timeout instead of rejecting every later send until restart.
    • Rust: sessions on a busy shared connection no longer lose session events, including external tool, permission and input requests, when notification routing falls behind.
    • SDK sessions now prioritize available enterprise-managed models over saved models when choosing a default model.
    • .NET, Python, Java: AHP hosts no longer reject remote session creation when the host policy sets skipCustomInstructions, coauthorEnabled or manageScheduleEnabled.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.32 Changelog Release notes →

  52. GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.110

    GitHub Copilot CLI

    Stable

    Released
    12 Nov 2026
    Changes
    190

    Experimental: answer git, ssh, and sudo password prompts from agent commands in a masked dialog (enable with /experimental on). Avoid unnecessary error popups during Microsoft Entra sign-in when an organization account is available. Screen readers identify the current session and announce when sessions need attention or are idle in the Sessions list.

    Key changes

    • Experimental: answer git, ssh, and sudo password prompts from agent commands in a masked dialog (enable with /experimental on)
    • Avoid unnecessary error popups during Microsoft Entra sign-in when an organization account is available
    • Screen readers identify the current session and announce when sessions need attention or are idle in the Sessions list

    $ gh release view v1.0.110 --repo github/copilot-cli
    All 190 changes

    Changes 190

    • Experimental: answer git, ssh, and sudo password prompts from agent commands in a masked dialog (enable with /experimental on)
    • Avoid unnecessary error popups during Microsoft Entra sign-in when an organization account is available
    • Screen readers identify the current session and announce when sessions need attention or are idle in the Sessions list
    • /usage model rows wrap at the terminal width instead of breaking at 100 columns
    • The / command picker no longer lists, preselects or runs a skill for a word that the skill's description hides inside a terminal escape sequence; only words the description shows match
    • Preserve keys typed just as the Ctrl+X shortcut window closes
    • Keep session rows and the selection cursor visible in the Sessions tab in narrow or short terminals
    • Preserve existing MCP configuration when /mcp add or /mcp edit encounters an invalid configuration file, and show a save error
    • Hide empty Thought rows when reasoning contains only invisible characters
    • Label partial responses and reasoning from interrupted or failed attempts as incomplete while preserving their text
    • Starting copilot from a directory that has since been deleted now says the directory no longer exists and how to recover, instead of crashing with a Node stack trace, and -C <directory> now works from there.
    • The workflow run tool no longer tells the model that a user reviews every run's limits when all tool permissions are pre-approved.
    • /compact respects the session AI credit limit, preventing additional charges once the limit is reached
    • Vim normal mode keeps j/k at line ends after $ or End and preserves the cursor column when using Up/Down across shorter lines
    • Plugin listings show enabled local marketplace plugins with missing directories as enabled but not loaded, with an explanation
    • /init suppress immediately hides the Getting started /init tip and keeps it hidden when returning to the folder.
    • Copying wrapped prompt text preserves typed line breaks without adding newlines at visual wraps
    • /worktree HEAD and /move HEAD create a worktree using the normalized branch name "head" instead of failing.
    • /session prune and its dry run skip sessions open in other processes and report how many were skipped
    • The /statusline preview keeps footer segments readable on narrow terminals
    • Ctrl+S in the /mcp add and edit forms saves once, with a single success message and server reload.
    • Ctrl+Y and /share research show their usual no-report messages instead of raw filesystem errors when the research folder cannot be read.
    • /lsp list and /lsp reload report syntax errors in your LSP configuration instead of a misleading missing-key error.
    • Unnamed sessions show their short ID in the Sessions tab and /resume list, keeping the same label after resuming
    • Assistant replies no longer indent or wrap the row after an inline code span that ends exactly at the right edge
    • With the Sessions sidebar docked, /lsp logs, the /every schedule manager, /workflows and the /mcp add form fit the pane beside it instead of being cut off at its edge
    • Mouse selections in scrolled-up conversations copy only highlighted text when released over the prompt or status line
    • Searches in /agent and the Sessions tab match visible text rather than hidden escape sequences.
    • Ctrl+R history search highlights, scrolls to, and places the cursor on matches with decomposed accents.
    • Installing, uninstalling, enabling or disabling a plugin, or adding or removing a marketplace, no longer erases your other plugin and marketplace settings when settings.json has an invalid value; the command now reports the error and leaves the file unchanged
    • Slash commands that fail at an idle prompt now show an error with the command name and reason
    • The slash-command picker underlines matching characters correctly in descriptions containing a capital dotted I.
    • /cwd, /cd, and /add-dir use the path you type when you press Enter before directory suggestions update
    • Pressing Enter twice on a permission prompt approves the request without showing a false retry warning
    • Prompt text wraps without splitting words that fit on a line, wrapping early, or adding stray leading spaces and blank lines
    • Keep accented and CJK characters intact when typing after keyboard shortcuts or pasting over slow terminal connections
    • Read JSON-valued settings, such as hook definitions, with copilot config <key> and /settings show <key>.
    • Ctrl+C stops a ! shell command even when pressed immediately after submitting it
    • Memory changes in /settings take effect without restarting the CLI
    • Preserve exact numbers, duplicate keys, and key order when displaying JSON tool results in previews and expanded views
    • Warn when repository settings override the reasoning effort for new sessions after saving a default with /model --global or /model --repo
    • /context shows loaded custom instructions as a separate token count instead of including them in System Prompt
    • Make /restart work when the CLI is launched with an attached directory argument such as -Csub or -C=sub
    • Show a single status entry when /compact is cancelled or has nothing to compact, without treating nothing to compact as an error
    • Keep /config and /settings readable beside the docked Sessions sidebar by fitting the layout to the available pane width
    • Show a warning when --yolo or --allow-all flags are ignored because bypass permissions mode is disabled, including in non-interactive runs
    • Shell completion works after --effort, --no-remote-export, and bare --sync-session flags; regenerate your completion script to apply
    • Report missing MCP servers as not found in copilot mcp remove and /mcp delete instead of suggesting a disable command that cannot find them
    • Show the MCP reload notice only once when /new worktree, /fork worktree, or /resume opens a session in another directory
    • Correct highlighting and emoji display in directory and agent pickers for names containing a capital dotted I.
    • /skills reload reports the same skill count as /skills list.
    • Allow copilot mcp enable for most servers even when mcp-config.json is invalid
    • Dialogs and tables fit beside the Sessions sidebar without clipped text or columns, and /sandbox fits narrow terminals.
    • Show custom agents marked user-invocable: false in /subagents so you can configure their models and turn them on or off
    • Show which plugin rules are off by default in copilot instruction list
    • Show names and file paths containing Markdown characters exactly as configured in /env
    • Keep text selections visible without adding color when NO_COLOR is set
    • Keep attachments and pasted text intact when clicking inside their labels in the prompt and typing
    • A postToolUse hook that rewrites a shell command's output, for example to redact a secret, again changes what the Shell row and copilot -p print, not only what the model receives
    • Apply URL rules saved in /settings to the active session without requiring a restart
    • Keep /model details visible when the Sessions sidebar is docked
    • Show changed files with non-UTF-8 filenames in /diff, including their patches
    • Preserve blank lines when copying text from the prompt with the mouse
    • Mouse scrolling and clicks in /settings and /config work correctly with the Sessions sidebar docked
    • Keep typed text visible and the cursor aligned after completing folder or agent names containing control characters
    • Show cancellation only once when interrupting a turn with Esc Esc while a /model switch is queued
    • Removing a problem in /settings keeps the selection on the first remaining row instead of jumping to an unrelated one
    • Keep tool results and assistant replies readable and aligned when they contain Unicode line or paragraph separators
    • Make Enter, Up and Down respond immediately after editing a short /search query, and start new queries at the bottom match
    • Remote MCP tools load and respond without timing out when server replies contain a truncated emoji
    • Keep group headings visible when scrolling back to the first item in /settings lists
    • /ask and /btw wait for sign-in to finish at startup and prompt signed-out users to run /login
    • Scrolling or clicking the Sessions sidebar leaves Configuration search results unchanged.
    • Preserve plugin enablement settings at startup when settings.json uses alternate key spellings and contains an invalid value
    • Avoid a five-second delay on /exit and /cd when stopping a session-owned indexed search server
    • Honor NO_COLOR for file-type badges and disable scrollbar thumb colors under NO_COLOR or TERM=dumb

    • Allow copilot mcp add and remove when mcp-config.json is a symlink to a file that does not exist yet

    • Keep emoji intact and wide session titles within the column limit in /ahp sessions
    • Keep remaining MCP servers' tool token counts accurate in /mcp after disabling a server with tool search enabled
    • Show refresh completion in the Installed view of /mcp, /skills, and /plugin instead of leaving the refreshing status on screen
    • Canceling "Session limit reached" clears waiting messages instead of sending them and reopening the dialog for each one
    • /mcp shows the correct repository or plugin origin for servers provided by custom agents
    • Exiting shell mode with Ctrl+C clears the exit hint so the next press warns before quitting
    • Keep the focused field and its options visible in MCP configuration forms when the terminal is resized
    • Keep the Sessions sidebar help's status legend fully visible in narrower panes

    • Prevent /mcp add and /mcp edit from overwriting an existing MCP server when its name is already in use

    • A local model added and selected from /model mid-session no longer shows Copilot plan quota and AI Credits in the footer, /usage or the exit summary

    • /move preserves edits to files marked assume-unchanged and reports submodule changes left in the original working tree
    • Changing a setting in /statusline preserves other footer settings updated by another session while the picker is open
    • Avoid unnecessary path access prompts for in-repository reads after shell commands that change directories
    • Keep permanently approved URLs approved after /new or /clear without restarting the CLI
    • JSON prompt mode emits a final result record when authentication fails or the prompt is blank
    • Reject prompt options combined with subcommands instead of silently dropping the prompt and running the subcommand
    • Pressing Enter after completing an empty directory path runs /add-dir or /cd reliably on Windows
    • Use the exact directory name typed in /cd, /cwd, and /add-dir instead of a similarly named sibling directory
    • Show control characters visibly in folder trust dialogs so folder names display without hidden formatting or extra lines
    • Show when files or directories are too large to read or list instead of reporting misleading counts in collapsed tool results
    • Warn when repository settings override a saved default model for new sessions, naming the model and settings file that still apply
    • Treat empty or fully commented repository settings files as empty settings without startup warnings or parsing errors
    • Keep the command description and exit status visible in collapsed failed shell rows with multi-line output
    • Show pasted terminal text plainly in Ctrl+R search and session confirmations so escape sequences cannot recolor or hide text
    • Sandbox settings show their effective defaults and toggle default-on options off on the first press
    • Show settings-file errors without duplicate, misleading policy-update warnings when settings.json is invalid
    • Hook changes saved from /settings apply to the next prompt without restarting the CLI
    • IDE auto-connect follows your current folder after /cd, keeping editor selections and diffs in the correct IDE
    • Expanded Shell output preserves text before and after diffs and shows file names for diff-only output
    • Keep copilot lsp list output free of warnings when plugin language servers load successfully
    • Deleting the active voice model now shows that voice mode is off and how to choose another model.
    • Show the output size instead of an incorrect match count when search results are too large to list
    • MCP server and skill enable/disable commands correctly report success for names supplied through --additional-mcp-config or --plugin-dir
    • Keep dialog borders and padding aligned when a line ends with an invisible zero-width character
    • List items in plan and task summaries stay on one line when they contain literal asterisks or sentences ending in numbers
    • Show the enabled state enforced by your organization's managed settings for built-in plugins in copilot plugin list and --json output
    • Apply changes to Disable bypass permissions mode in /settings immediately, without restarting the CLI
    • /cd, /cwd, and /add-dir select the exact directory name you type when siblings differ only by case or accents
    • Hide custom agents with built-in names from /subagents so their controls cannot change built-in agent settings
    • Preserve first-line indentation in shell command output so expanded Shell rows correctly show spacing-sensitive results such as git status --short
    • Shell commands terminated by a signal report the correct exit status, such as 137 for SIGKILL or 139 for a segmentation fault
    • Show a confirmation when a model switch queued while the agent is working takes effect
    • Show the output size instead of an incorrect line count in Shell summaries when command output is too large to display
    • Footer context usage shows the same pre-request percentage as /context.
    • Plan quota and Copilot usage stay visible in the status line, /usage and the exit summary while a GitHub-hosted model is selected, even when providers.json configures a custom provider; they are hidden only while a model from that provider is selected
    • Prompt history is no longer hidden, and then erased by the next prompt, when the file that stores session mentions for past prompts is damaged or was written by a newer version
    • The ctrl+y footer hint no longer misses a plan written right after the session starts, and it keeps updating when the plan file cannot be watched
    • Hook events and other JSON settings can be saved from their editor in /settings; unset hook events now open as an empty list
    • Resuming a session by name with --resume no longer sends the session name in telemetry; only a session ID is reported
    • Exiting no longer writes dozens of errors to the process log about cleaning up a session that has already shut down
    • /sandbox no longer replaces your saved sandbox settings with defaults when settings.json has an invalid value; it shows the load error instead, and a sandbox path saved from a permission prompt is refused rather than overwriting the sandbox block
    • A prompt submitted while Compact and switch is compacting shows as queued again, instead of disappearing until the compaction finishes
    • Disabling an MCP server updates its token count in /mcp without waiting for another model response
    • On Linux, language servers that watch files are no longer told that files still on disk were deleted after two files or directories are swapped through a temporary name
    • copilot -p in a trusted folder no longer sometimes runs without the repository's hooks when plugins finish loading at the same time
    • copilot mcp remove and /mcp remove now delete an mcp-config.json entry that is skipped as invalid instead of reporting that the server was not found
    • Resuming a session by ID or name with /resume now keeps the session you leave open in the background, so it still runs its sessionEnd hooks, records its shutdown and is listed when you exit
    • copilot -p and other CLI runs that exit within a minute now apply process-log retention, so old logs are removed after 7 days and beyond the newest 50 instead of piling up one per run
    • copilot plugin marketplace add ./name, ../name and ~/name now add the local marketplace directory instead of trying to clone a GitHub repository
    • A shell command killed because the sandbox settings changed while it ran is now reported as failed instead of as a successful command with no output
    • The warning for an unsupported --reasoning-effort value is no longer lost when the session's model changes while the CLI is starting
    • copilot help '' prints the general help and exits successfully, just like copilot help.
    • A /compact with nothing to compact no longer leaves a stale "Compacting conversation history..." row in the timeline
    • An mcp-config.json that cannot be read or is not a JSON object now fails with an error that names the file and the actual problem, and a syntax error in a file with comments or trailing commas points at the real mistake instead of the first comment or comma
    • Selecting an unavailable account in /user switch shows recovery guidance and a retry action
    • Click anywhere in expanded reasoning to collapse it without scrolling back to the header
    • Offer a session AI-credit limit top-up at 90% usage, before the agent loses access to tools
    • Remove legacy remote steering; cloud sessions and remote connections now require an AHP environment

    All 69 changes

    Highlights 5

    • When an MCP server such as Slack needs you to sign in again, the conversation now offers the matching connector and can connect it in place and resume your task.
    • Reaction tooltips on issue and pull request comments and descriptions now show who reacted.
    • Diffs now show a neutral gap indicator between separated excerpts of a file, making omitted unchanged lines easier to spot.

    Added 3

    • Diffs now show a neutral gap indicator between separated excerpts of a file, making omitted unchanged lines easier to spot.
    • Reaction tooltips on issue and pull request comments and descriptions now show who reacted.
    • When an MCP server such as Slack needs you to sign in again, the conversation now offers the matching connector, which stays signed in, and can connect it in place and resume your task.

    Changed 2

    • Questions from a coordinated child session now stay in that child session instead of being repeated to the parent agent or creating a second prompt when relayed.
    • The automation run title menu now matches the session title menu, with Schedule and Usage submenus, an Enabled switch, and shorter Edit, Copy link and Delete actions

    Fixed 59

    • A finished plan review now keeps its outcome, such as the plan changes you requested or that you approved the plan, under the "Plan created" card in the chat.
    • Adding a repository from Quick Open by pasting its URL now selects it in the new chat's repository picker once the clone finishes.
    • Agents in Azure DevOps sessions can now comment on other pull requests and start new comment threads instead of refusing
    • An empty New file or rename box in the Files panel now closes when you click away, even after pressing Enter on it more than once. Pressing Enter on a blank name now asks you to enter a file or folder name.
    • Blank lines in composer drafts are now preserved when you navigate away and return to a session
    • Changing the model twice while a reply is streaming no longer shows the "Model changed" rows in reverse order
    • Closing the date range picker after choosing "is between" on a date filter no longer leaves the filter reading "Select a range" while the previous date is still applied
    • Conversation timeline previews are easier to reach: moving diagonally from a tick to its preview card no longer dismisses it or selects a neighboring tick.
    • Creating a new file in the Files panel with the name of an existing file no longer empties that file; it now shows an error instead
    • Dashboard widgets no longer reload their content when you move them to a different position or column
    • Deleted sessions no longer reappear in the sidebar after a delayed refresh.
    • Dismissing the line range tip above a file with the keyboard now moves focus into the file, with a visible focus ring, instead of dropping it.
    • Fixed an Advanced filter in My Work showing a condition count on its pill while its conditions were not applied to the list.
    • Fixed the New automation dialog wrongly reporting a local project as unavailable and blocking Start session after switching from Create manually to Create with agent
    • Fixed uploaded images and saved folder access being blocked in sessions where your organization's policy requires the sandbox.
    • Forking a chat from a response now updates the URL to the forked chat, so Back, Forward, and the restored route on next launch point to the fork instead of the original chat
    • In My work, the Created, Updated, Merged and Comments filters no longer silently drop a second bound when you edit them in Simple mode, and an inclusive date window now shows as one "is between" filter.
    • In narrow windows or at high zoom, an open chat or Project panel now fills the whole area instead of squeezing the conversation and panel side by side
    • In the My work filter bar, the Milestone, Project, Base and Head filters now show every value in the query, including excluded ones ("is not"), and removing one value no longer drops the others
    • Install plugin in a repository's Code tab now finds plugin marketplace catalogs at the repository root and in .plugin/marketplace.json
    • Keyboard focus now moves to the Automations heading when you use the breadcrumb to go back to the automations gallery, so focus is no longer lost and screen readers announce the page.
    • Keyboard shortcuts such as Ctrl+F, Ctrl+W and Ctrl+B now work on Hindi and Thai keyboard layouts.
    • MCP server badges in Customize no longer flip from Connected to "Connecting…" when you return to the page and a server is slow to reconnect.
    • New automations and Side chats no longer fail when your saved default model is no longer available; they now start on the default model instead.
    • On Windows, shutting down, restarting or signing out while the app is running no longer shows a "git.exe - Application Error" popup for each session worktree.
    • Opening or switching back to a conversation with Mermaid diagrams no longer makes the conversation jump while the diagrams render again
    • Plan and usage links in Settings > Accounts now tell screen readers that they open in a new browser tab
    • Project Overview sections now stay collapsed or expanded when you switch to another Project and back
    • Pull request and issue cards an agent publishes from a GitHub Enterprise Cloud data-residency (ghe.com) repository open in the browser instead of failing
    • Pull request checks no longer appear empty when they only partially load or fail to load, and a Retry action is now available.
    • Removed the distracting outline that could appear around the image viewer when opening an image preview
    • Renaming a project no longer moves it to the top of the sidebar
    • Renaming a repository session no longer moves it to the top of the sidebar or marks it as just updated
    • Repository pickers in the New session composer and New automation dialog now find repositories when you search by owner or owner/name.
    • Running /restart-session in a new Project no longer moves keyboard focus from the message box to the onboarding cards
    • Saving an existing file from the editor now keeps its original permissions, so executable scripts stay executable instead of being reset to owner-only access.
    • Screen readers and voice control now announce the Advanced filter condition buttons by the field, operator, and value shown on screen.
    • Screen readers now announce that "See subscriptions" and "Open Copilot settings" on the onboarding screens open in a new browser tab.
    • Screen readers now announce the "is" or "is not" operator on typed and date filters in the Pull requests, Issues and My work filter bars
    • Screen readers now announce the number of results (or the empty state) after you search in Inbox and Sessions widgets
    • Sending a prompt while a reply is running in a very long conversation does less work for every earlier turn.
    • Splitting or moving a tab in the side panel now keeps keyboard focus on the moved tab instead of leaving it in the old pane or dropping it to the page body
    • Starting a chat from Home on a remote environment such as WSL no longer fails when the selected model isn't available there; Home now lists the environment's own models and falls back to its default.
    • Switching back to a conversation with a Mermaid diagram no longer makes the conversation jump after it first appears
    • The agent now asks for your approval, showing the repository, title and body, before creating a GitHub issue in local sessions, including when tool permissions are set to Allow All or Assisted
    • The Automations page no longer reports that automations couldn't be checked for repositories that have cloud automations turned off, such as public repositories you can't manage
    • The Change theme button in Settings > General is no longer cut off in narrow windows or at high zoom levels
    • The Changes view now keeps your place in the diff when you switch to another session and back
    • The Chats group in the Sessions sidebar shows a + button on hover again, so you can start a new chat in one click.
    • The Connection Lost screen now appears above Settings and other open dialogs, keeps keyboard focus on Try again, and returns focus to where you were when the connection comes back.
    • The conversation timeline preview card now returns to the keyboard-selected prompt when the pointer leaves, instead of staying on the last prompt you hovered.
    • The elapsed time on a chat's progress row now counts from when the running turn started, so a reloaded window or a chat opened in a new window no longer restarts at 0s.
    • The file sidebar in the Files and Changes tabs no longer squeezes the file or diff view down to nothing in narrow or split panes
    • The prompt composer no longer deletes a word typed directly in front of a pasted GitHub link when it converts the link into a reference chip
    • The repository trust review dialog now always shows that instructions were cut off, even when the excerpt contains emoji.
    • The taskbar and dock badge no longer counts hidden cloud workers that the sidebar does not list, and the dock menu no longer lists them
    • The two number boxes in the Comments filter's "is between" option are now announced by screen readers as "Minimum" and "Maximum", and their placeholders are no longer cut off
    • Unpinning a session from the sidebar with the keyboard no longer loses focus when the session's group is collapsed
    • When sending a message fails in a remote or cloud session, the message and its attachments now return to the composer instead of disappearing.

  57. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.32-preview.2

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Prerelease

    Released
    11 Nov 2026
    Changes
    33

    Session usage and model-call failure events can now report /interactions as the API endpoint, for Gemini models served over the native Gemini Interactions API. Added JSON-RPC HTTP APIs with text, streaming, and caller-owned file response modes.

    Key changes

    • Session usage and model-call failure events can now report /interactions as the API endpoint, for Gemini models served over the native Gemini Interactions API.
    • Added JSON-RPC HTTP APIs with text, streaming, and caller-owned file response modes.
    • skill.invoked events from the skill tool, web_fetch URL permission requests, and file write prompt requests now omit absent optional fields instead of sending null, and no longer include an internal routing field, so they match the session events schema.
    • Fix MCP client attribution to use the calling application's identity and refresh it on reconnect.
    $ gh release view v1.0.32-preview.2 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 33 changes

    Changes 33

    • Session usage and model-call failure events can now report /interactions as the API endpoint, for Gemini models served over the native Gemini Interactions API.
    • Added JSON-RPC HTTP APIs with text, streaming, and caller-owned file response modes.
    • skill.invoked events from the skill tool, web_fetch URL permission requests, and file write prompt requests now omit absent optional fields instead of sending null, and no longer include an internal routing field, so they match the session events schema.
    • Fix MCP client attribution to use the calling application's identity and refresh it on reconnect.
    • Custom Windows-convention session filesystem providers support application-configured UNC paths, including additional directories and resume working directories.
    • When an enabled installed plugin's files are missing, sessions now start their other extensions and emit a plugin_activation session warning naming the plugin, instead of failing extension startup or resume.
    • Added an experimental authenticateBasic callback to the network client option, which supplies credentials when a proxy asks for Basic authentication.
    • Respect managed plugin policy when selecting or restoring a custom agent.
    • BYOK providers accept type: "google" to use Google's native Gemini Interactions API (x-goog-api-key auth).
    • fetch.send and fetch.read now report a timeoutMs or readTimeoutMs expiry during a request as FetchTransportErrorData kind "timeout" instead of "request" ("tunnel" through a Negotiate proxy).
    • A postToolUse hook that returns only textResultForLlm for a shell result now also changes that result's detailedContent, so a redaction reaches what clients display.
    • Add runtime-owned IDE endpoints through existing MCP lifecycle methods, MCP tool calls, live IDE state, and ordinary session events.
    • Preserve required serializer nulls, reuse canonical Python and Java event types, and dispose disconnected Python and Go owners before reconnect.
    • Every send blocked by a session AI-credit limit now reports the block, and in non-interactive sessions each blocked sendAndWait rejects with the session limit error instead of only the first; raising the limit with session.options.update re-arms the exhausted warning.
    • Requesting a fusionTier for a BYOK provider's model named fusion now fails with an error that names fusionTier instead of autoTier.
    • Use compatible editing tools and model-specific token and reasoning defaults for additional BYOK model names, including GPT-4o.
    • Tool completion events for a tool that sets no session log, such as grep and glob, now carry detailedContent without a postToolUse hook's additionalContext; the model text in content still includes it.
    • includedBuiltinAgents or excludedBuiltinAgents with a non-string entry is now rejected with an error instead of leaving a session whose every send fails.
    • disabledMcpServers with a non-string entry is now rejected with an error instead of silently starting every disabled MCP server.
    • session.history.truncate on a resumed session no longer lets the next prompt write the removed resume record back to the session log.
    • session.metadata.contextInfo and session.metadata.getContextAttribution return null after a session is resumed until its tools initialize, instead of a measurement that leaves out the built-in tools.
    • Go: calling Start again after the runtime process exits now retires the sessions of the lost connection, so a SendAndWait still waiting on one of them fails immediately and Stop no longer reports errors for them.
    • Update the Java SDK's Jackson dependencies to 2.23.
    • mcp.config.add and mcp.config.update no longer replace an mcp-config.json entry that is skipped as invalid; they return an error that says to remove it first.
    • A tool call no longer hangs when the host removes that tool with setTools while the call waits for permission; the call fails with a tool-unavailable result and the turn finishes.
    • Sandboxed command hook and local MCP initialization errors can identify a filesystem operation reported by the process; hook errors can also identify a blocked proxy connection.
    • Fix Java in-process runtime cleanup when startup is interrupted.
    • Report a person's answers to ask_user, user-input, plan-review and elicitation prompts with the same decisionContext label permission answers use (Node.js createAttributedResult, Python create_attributed_result, Rust AttributedResult, Go OnAttributed*Request handlers, and a DecisionContext on the .NET and Java handler results); the runtime accepts it only from the session's owning connection.
    • Copilot Connectors that an SDK host supplies are no longer blocked by an organization's "Registry only" MCP registry policy; managed allow and deny lists still apply.
    • With tool search on, session.tools.getCurrentMetadata and session.mcp.getToolTokenBreakdown now report the deferral the next request will use after the tool set changes, instead of the last request's.
    • Sessions now accept new messages after a host event acknowledgement timeout instead of rejecting every later send until restart.
    • Rust: sessions on a busy shared connection no longer lose session events, including external tool, permission and input requests, when notification routing falls behind.
    • SDK sessions now prioritize available enterprise-managed models over saved models when choosing a default model.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.32-preview.2 Changelog Release notes →

    • Prompt text wraps without splitting words that fit on a line, wrapping early, or adding stray leading spaces and blank lines
    • Keep accented and CJK characters intact when typing after keyboard shortcuts or pasting over slow terminal connections
    • Read JSON-valued settings, such as hook definitions, with copilot config <key> and /settings show <key>.

    • Memory changes in /settings take effect without restarting the CLI
    • Preserve exact numbers, duplicate keys, and key order when displaying JSON tool results in previews and expanded views
    • Warn when repository settings override the reasoning effort for new sessions after saving a default with /model --global or /model --repo
    • /context shows loaded custom instructions as a separate token count instead of including them in System Prompt
    • Make /restart work when the CLI is launched with an attached directory argument such as -Csub or -C=sub
    • Show a single status entry when /compact is cancelled or has nothing to compact, without treating nothing to compact as an error
    • Keep /config and /settings readable beside the docked Sessions sidebar by fitting the layout to the available pane width
    • Show a warning when --yolo or --allow-all flags are ignored because bypass permissions mode is disabled, including in non-interactive runs
    • Shell completion works after --effort, --no-remote-export, and bare --sync-session flags; regenerate your completion script to apply
    • Report missing MCP servers as not found in copilot mcp remove and /mcp delete instead of suggesting a disable command that cannot find them
    • Show the MCP reload notice only once when /new worktree, /fork worktree, or /resume opens a session in another directory
    • Correct highlighting and emoji display in directory and agent pickers for names containing a capital dotted I.

    • Allow copilot mcp add and remove when mcp-config.json is a symlink to a file that does not exist yet
    • Assistant replies with no visible content no longer display an empty bullet in the conversation.

    • Keep emoji intact and wide session titles within the column limit in /ahp sessions
    • Keep remaining MCP servers' tool token counts accurate in /mcp after disabling a server with tool search enabled
    • Show refresh completion in the Installed view of /mcp, /skills, and /plugin instead of leaving the refreshing status on screen
    • Canceling "Session limit reached" clears waiting messages instead of sending them and reopening the dialog for each one
    • /mcp shows the correct repository or plugin origin for servers provided by custom agents
    • Exiting shell mode with Ctrl+C clears the exit hint so the next press warns before quitting
    • Keep the focused field and its options visible in MCP configuration forms when the terminal is resized
    • Keep the Sessions sidebar help's status legend fully visible in narrower panes
    • Several CLIs started at once after the user lookup expired no longer look the user up twice and wait for the second lookup before starting

    • Prevent /mcp add and /mcp edit from overwriting an existing MCP server when its name is already in use
    • copilot -p now warns on stderr and in JSON output when it cannot start MCP servers, for example because the user's mcp-config.json cannot be parsed, instead of continuing without them silently
    • A local model added and selected from /model mid-session no longer shows Copilot plan quota and AI Credits in the footer, /usage or the exit summary
    • copilot plugin marketplace list, browse and update run from a subdirectory of a repository find the repository's relative directory marketplace under the repository root instead of under the current directory
    • Preserve existing invalid MCP server configurations when installing a server with the same name
    • On macOS 13 and earlier, the CLI now says it requires macOS 14 or later instead of exiting with a native addon loading error
    • /remote on and /remote share now say that your organization has disabled remote control, instead of sending you to /environments to enable incoming connections, which that policy also blocks
    • The exit summary shows AI Credits again when a providers.json is configured but a GitHub-hosted model is selected, matching /usage and the footer
    • Honor the Assisted Permissions startup default when user settings contain an administrator-only restriction that does not apply
    • An MCP sign-in that is waiting in the browser now stops when the server is blocked by the account's third-party MCP policy, instead of finishing the sign-in and saving tokens for a server that can no longer be used
    • Search rows for grep and glob no longer count a postToolUse hook's additionalContext as results, so a search that matched nothing no longer reads 4 files found
    • The /settings dialog and /config no longer show streamerMode to accounts that cannot use /streamer-mode; an account whose settings already have it on still sees the row, so it can turn it off
    • Indexed search keeps reconnecting after occasional connection losses in long sessions instead of switching to ripgrep for the rest of the session
    • Accepting or rejecting an IDE diff works even when another MCP server changes status

  62. GitHub Copilot SDK v1.0.32-preview.0

    GitHub Copilot SDK

    Prerelease

    Released
    10 Nov 2026
    Changes
    18

    Fix managed-account changes stalling while live extensions restart and rejoin the session. Copilot SDKs can now answer sudo, SSH, and Git password prompts from commands the agent runs, through a new shell authentication handler. Answers go only to the program that asked.

    Key changes

    • Fix managed-account changes stalling while live extensions restart and rejoin the session.
    • Copilot SDKs can now answer sudo, SSH, and Git password prompts from commands the agent runs, through a new shell authentication handler. Answers go only to the program that asked.
    • Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, Rust: A request handler no longer keeps memory for each response the runtime cancels after the handler has finished it, such as a response rejected for exceeding the response size limit.
    • Adding a marketplace from a two-segment relative or home path such as ./name, ../name or ~/name now adds the local directory instead of cloning a GitHub repository
    $ gh release view v1.0.32-preview.0 --repo github/copilot-sdk
    All 18 changes

    Changes 18

    • Fix managed-account changes stalling while live extensions restart and rejoin the session.
    • Copilot SDKs can now answer sudo, SSH, and Git password prompts from commands the agent runs, through a new shell authentication handler. Answers go only to the program that asked.
    • Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, Rust: A request handler no longer keeps memory for each response the runtime cancels after the handler has finished it, such as a response rejected for exceeding the response size limit.
    • Adding a marketplace from a two-segment relative or home path such as ./name, ../name or ~/name now adds the local directory instead of cloning a GitHub repository
    • Ending a session with disconnect, deleteSession or client stop now stops the background shell commands it started without detach, instead of leaving them running after the runtime exits.
    • Forward supplied SDK correlation IDs to Memory requests, preserving replacements on session resume.
    • .NET: Fix the manual tool-resume sample build by using the permission-decision factory with a scoped experimental-API suppression.
    • mcp.config.remove now deletes a user MCP config entry that fails validation instead of reporting that the server was not found
    • Fixed MCP servers restarting when a session shuts down while a connection is completing.
    • Entra-derived Loki account IDs remain stable across endpoint and display-name changes.
    • session.schedule.addCron now rejects cron expressions with a seconds or year field, matching its 5-field contract, and reports an unknown time zone by name instead of as an invalid cron expression.
    • A synchronous bash tool call killed by a sandbox configuration change now fails with an explicit error instead of reporting an empty success.
    • Fixed an issue where /every and /after prompts with natural-language times could lose line breaks and indentation.
    • session.shell.exec now runs a command with a relative cwd under the session working directory instead of the runtime process's directory.
    • Session AI-credit limits now show the model a dollar cost meter after each successful tool call instead of a per-call countdown, and interactive clients with a session-limits listener are offered a top-up at 90% of the limit, before tools are disabled.
    • Preserved graceful shutdown during managed SDK bootstrap.
    • Fix custom agents losing delegation-only tools when availableTools and defaultAgent.excludedTools are combined.
    • session.tools.getCurrentMetadata and session.mcp.getToolTokenBreakdown no longer report a disabled MCP server's tools after a model request.
    Source: github/copilot-sdkTag: v1.0.32-preview.0 Changelog Release notes →

    $ gh release view v1.2.0 --repo github/app
    All 432 changes

    Highlights 5

    • Continue cloud and Codespace sessions on your phone with a new "Open in" menu and GitHub mobile app QR code.
    • Dictation now supports French, Spanish, and other languages via a downloadable multilingual voice model.
    • GitHub Enterprise Server accounts can now be added from Settings → Accounts, with repositories, issues, and pull requests available.
    • Filter Issues and Pull requests by custom fields, such as a GitHub Project's Size.
